sophisticated.sentenceEn: What may happen to your baggage even when there are sophisticated automated systems?
sophisticated.translationZh: 即使有先进的自动化系统，您的行李仍可能遇到什么情况？

sophisticated.sentenceEn: It involves lots of sophisticated mental activity.
sophisticated.translationZh: 它需要复杂的思维活动。

specifically.sentenceEn: An effective simulation can be better than experience as a learning tool because it accelerates time, compresses space, and unlike reality, is specifically designed to maximize participant learning.
specifically.translationZh: 作为一种学习工具，有效的模拟可能比实际经验更优越，因为它能加速时间、压缩空间，而且与现实不同，模拟是专门为最大限度提升参与者学习效果而设计的。
specifically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

specifically.sentenceEn: A paper by Bowker and her colleagues was the first to show that a type of social withdrawal could have a positive effect—they found that creativity was linked specifically to unsociability.
specifically.translationZh: Bowker及其同事的一篇论文首次表明，某种类型的社交退缩可能产生积极影响——他们发现创造力与不合群特质存在特定关联。

specifically.sentenceEn: The study specifically focused on curiosity levels, which are associated with enhanced learning and higher academic achievement in reading and math at kindergarten, and behavioral-developmental benefits, especially for children from families with lower socioeconomic status.
specifically.translationZh: 该研究特别关注了好奇心水平，这种好奇心与幼儿园阶段阅读和数学学习能力的提升、学业成绩的提高有关，并且还具有行为发展方面的益处，尤其对来自社会经济地位较低家庭的儿童而言。
specifically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

specifically.sentenceEn: But sometimes, the good guys also get punished or criticized, specifically because they are so good.
specifically.translationZh: 但有时候，好人也会受到惩罚或批评，而这恰恰是因为他们太好了。
specifically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

specifically.sentenceEn: It was specifically stressful work environments, minimal training and a lack of accountability that were found to be the most blameworthy.
specifically.translationZh: 研究发现，尤其应该受到指责的是充满压力的工作环境、微不足道的培训以及责任感的缺失。
specifically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

specifically.sentenceEn: What did Prachi Shah's study specifically focus on?
specifically.translationZh: 普拉奇·沙阿的研究具体关注什么内容？

sustainability.sentenceEn: The Urban Libraries Council released a report detailing the unique ways in which libraries can further sustainability at the local level.
sustainability.translationZh: 城市图书馆理事会发布了一份报告，详细阐述了图书馆在地方层面促进可持续发展的独特方式。

sustainability.sentenceEn: Unlimited growth is not sustainable, and economic thinking is moving toward the idea that we should aim for sustainability in our economic models.
sustainability.translationZh: 无限增长是不可持续的，经济思想正朝着我们应当以经济模式可持续性为目标的方向转变。
sustainability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

sustainability.sentenceEn: With population increases and global urbanisation ever accelerating, much attention is focused on the sustainability of our cities and scarce attention is paid to the countryside.
sustainability.translationZh: 随着人口增长和全球城市化进程的不断加速，人们的注意力大多集中在城市的可持续发展上，而对农村地区的关注则少之又少。
sustainability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

sustainability.sentenceEn: Sustainability matters, but marketable design appears to matter more to these companies.
sustainability.translationZh: 可持续发展固然重要，但对这些公司而言，具有市场吸引力的设计似乎更为关键。
sustainability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

sustainability.sentenceEn: What should tech companies do to help ensure environmental sustainability ?
sustainability.translationZh: 科技公司应该做些什么来帮助确保环境可持续性？

sustainability.sentenceEn: It will ensure the sustainability of the fishing industry around the coast.
sustainability.translationZh: 它将确保沿海渔业的可持续发展。

sarcasm.sentenceEn: Sarcasm is mostly understood through tone of voice, which is used to portray the opposite of the literal words.
sarcasm.translationZh: 讽刺大多通过语气来表达，这种语气用于传达与字面意思相反的含义。
sarcasm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

sarcasm.sentenceEn: Hence, it's no wonder that sarcasm is often preceded by the word "cutting" and that it hurts.
sarcasm.translationZh: 因此，难怪人们常用“尖锐”一词来形容讽刺，而讽刺确实伤人。
sarcasm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

sarcasm.sentenceEn: In essence, sarcasm is easy while true, harmless wit takes talent.
sarcasm.translationZh: 本质上，讽刺很容易，但真正无害的机智则需要天赋。
sarcasm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

sarcasm.sentenceEn: But a big or steady serving of sarcasm will overwhelm the emotional flavor of any conversation and can taste very bitter to its recipient.
sarcasm.translationZh: 但大量或频繁的讽刺会盖过任何对话的情感基调，给听者留下苦涩的感受。
sarcasm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

sarcasm.sentenceEn: Indeed, it's not surprising that the origin of the word sarcasm derives from the Greek word "sarkazein" which literally means "to tear or strip the flesh off."
sarcasm.translationZh: 事实上，讽刺(sarcasm)一词源于希腊语"sarkazein"，字面意思是"撕肉或剥皮"，这并不奇怪。
sarcasm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

sarcasm.sentenceEn: Why does the author say sarcasm and jazz have something surprisingly in common?
sarcasm.translationZh: 为什么作者说讽刺和爵士乐有着令人惊讶的共同点？

saving.sentenceEn: In an ever-more complex and synthetic world, our saving powers won't come from a single source, and certainly not from a too-big-to-fail approach or from those who have been drawn into the whirlpool of our age of speed.
saving.translationZh: 在一个日益复杂和综合的世界里，我们的拯救力量不会来自单一源头，更不可能来自某种"大而不倒"的方法，也不会来自那些已被卷入这个速度时代漩涡的人们。

saving.sentenceEn: Experts say more hospitals are likely to invest in telemedicine systems as they move away from fee-for-service payments and into managed-care-type contracts that give them a set fee to provide care for patients and allow them to keep any savings they achieve.
saving.translationZh: 专家表示，随着医院逐步摆脱按服务收费模式，转向管理型医疗合同——这类合同为医院提供固定费用用于患者护理，并允许医院保留所实现的任何节余——更多医院可能会投资远程医疗系统。

saving.sentenceEn: Allocate a tiny amount of 1 or 2 percent for savings , and gradually increase that amount.
saving.translationZh: 先将1%或2%的小额收入用于储蓄，然后逐步提高这一比例。
saving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

saving.sentenceEn: But for many young people, it'll be difficult to designate such a large proportion of their income for savings .
saving.translationZh: 但是对于许多年轻人来说，要将如此大比例的收入用于储蓄会很困难。
saving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

saving.sentenceEn: I need around 20% more in personal savings and 50% less debt.
saving.translationZh: 我需要把个人储蓄再增加20%，债务再减少50%。
saving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第6句

saving.sentenceEn: Retirement savings should come first in one's family budgeting.
saving.translationZh: 在家庭预算规划中，退休储蓄应放在首位。

scenario.sentenceEn: M: Well, depending on the ensuing operative scenario , if I need to wipe the system directories clean in order to reconfigure default protocols, then my first intervention should be to intricately retrieve all inventories that I can.
scenario.translationZh: 男：嗯，这取决于接下来的操作场景。如果我需要清空系统目录以重新配置默认协议，那么我的首要措施应该是尽可能详细地检索所有清单。
scenario.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

scenario.sentenceEn: This simulation gives the child crucial information about how to avoid becoming prey, and children tend to find that kind of activity deeply satisfying, presumably because it gives them a safe experience of a potentially catastrophic scenario .
scenario.translationZh: 这种模拟为孩子提供了关于如何避免成为猎物的重要信息，而孩子们往往发现这类活动非常令人满足，可能是因为它让他们在安全的环境中体验了潜在的灾难性情景。
scenario.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

scenario.sentenceEn: Imagine this scenario —a person is walking down the street smelling a scent that they first encountered decades ago, which activates an emotional response.
scenario.translationZh: 想象这样一个场景：一个人走在街上，闻到了几十年前首次闻到的一种气味，这引发了一种情感反应。
scenario.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

scenario.sentenceEn: We have learned to worry about asteroids(小行星) and super volcanoes, but the more likely scenario , according to Nick Bostrom, a professor of philosophy at Oxford, is that we humans will destroy ourselves.
scenario.translationZh: 我们已经学会了担忧小行星和超级火山，但牛津大学哲学教授尼克·博斯特罗姆认为，更可能发生的情况是人类自我毁灭。
scenario.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

scenario.sentenceEn: The researchers compared brain responses to statements expressing factual scenarios and those expressing possibility.
scenario.translationZh: 研究人员比较了大脑对表达事实情景的陈述与表达可能性的陈述的反应。
scenario.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

scenario.sentenceEn: Robots can have trouble making decisions in complex scenarios .
scenario.translationZh: 机器人在复杂场景中可能难以做出决策。

significantly.sentenceEn: It has been found that listening to classical music significantly reduces a person's blood pressure.
significantly.translationZh: 研究发现，聆听古典音乐能显著降低人的血压。
significantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

significantly.sentenceEn: Low-income countries, including China and India, have been growing at a significantly faster pace in recent decades and are quickly catching up to the West.
significantly.translationZh: 包括中国和印度在内的低收入国家近几十年来一直以显著更快的速度增长，并正在迅速追赶西方国家。
significantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

significantly.sentenceEn: Crucially, the proportion of female editors was significantly lower than the overall proportion of women psychology researchers.
significantly.translationZh: 关键的是，女性编辑的比例显著低于女性心理学研究者的总体比例。
significantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

significantly.sentenceEn: In this case, the proportion of female editors was not significantly lower than the proportion of female researchers working in neuroscience—a finding that reveals enduring gender disparities in the field more broadly.
significantly.translationZh: 在神经科学领域，女性编辑的比例并不显著低于该领域女性研究人员的总体比例——这一发现更广泛地揭示了该领域长期存在的性别差距。
significantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

significantly.sentenceEn: A study showed that dual-language students did significantly better than their peers in reading English texts.
significantly.translationZh: 一项研究显示，双语项目学生在英语文本阅读方面的表现显著优于同龄人。

significantly.sentenceEn: It can improve our financial status significantly .
significantly.translationZh: 它能显著改善我们的经济状况。

simulation.sentenceEn: To reap the benefits, however, simulations must feel like reality.
simulation.translationZh: 然而，要想获得这些益处，模拟必须让人感觉如同现实一般。
simulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

simulation.sentenceEn: Well-designed simulations can enable individuals and groups to develop a deep level of understanding about how their decisions and intuitive responses to business stimuli affect their fellow participants and the organization as a whole.
simulation.translationZh: 精心设计的模拟能够让个人和团队深入理解他们的决策以及对业务刺激的直觉反应如何影响其他参与者和整个组织。
simulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

simulation.sentenceEn: Simulations provide an immersive learning experience where skills, processes and knowledge all can be highlighted in a way reality cannot.
simulation.translationZh: 模拟提供沉浸式学习体验，能够以现实无法实现的方式突出技能、流程和知识。
simulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

simulation.sentenceEn: To maximize benefits from simulation , participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing.
simulation.translationZh: 为了充分发挥模拟训练的效益，参与者应立即将从中获得的经验应用于实践，从而在学习与行动之间建立顺畅的联系。
simulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

simulation.sentenceEn: What makes simulation one of the most fruitful forms of learning?
simulation.translationZh: 是什么让模拟成为最富有成效的学习形式之一？

simulation.sentenceEn: They are interventions different from simulations in creating stimuli for change.
simulation.translationZh: 它们是不同于模拟的干预措施，旨在创造变革的刺激因素。

solar.sentenceEn: But cows, sheep and other ruminant(反刍的) animals can break cellulose down and release the solar energy contained in this vast resource.
solar.translationZh: 但牛、羊和其他反刍动物能够分解纤维素，并释放这一巨大资源中蕴含的太阳能。

solar.sentenceEn: Wind and solar power generation has increased over 400% since 2010, and renewables provided 46% of the country's electricity in 2019.
solar.translationZh: 自2010年以来，风能和太阳能发电量增长了400%以上，2019年可再生能源占全国电力供应的46%。
solar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

solar.sentenceEn: The instability of renewables doesn't just mean energy is often not produced at night, but also that solar and wind can overwhelm the grid during the day, forcing utilities to pay customers to use their electricity.
solar.translationZh: 可再生能源的不稳定性不仅意味着夜晚往往无法产生能源，还意味着白天太阳能和风能可能会使电网不堪重负，迫使电力公司不得不付费让用户用电。
solar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

solar.sentenceEn: I've seen quite a few with solar panels that provide electricity for when you're stopped.
solar.translationZh: 我见过不少露营车都装有太阳能板，在你停车的时候可以供电。
solar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

solar.sentenceEn: Nearly 1.5 million visitors flock here every year to watch rockets, spacecraft, and satellites blast off into the solar system from Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex.
solar.translationZh: 每年有近150万游客涌向这里，在肯尼迪航天中心游客综合区观看火箭、航天器和卫星发射升空，飞向太阳系。

solar.sentenceEn: It has increased its wind and solar power generation four times over the last two decades.
solar.translationZh: 在过去二十年中，其风能和太阳能发电量增长了四倍。

solidarity.sentenceEn: Acting out of solidarity means supporting and standing up for each other — in recognition that one's fate is in the fate of the other.
solidarity.translationZh: 以团结的精神行事意味着相互支持和挺身而出——因为我们意识到，彼此的命运休戚与共。
solidarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第7句

solidarity.sentenceEn: Solidarity is also viewed as a reaction to the extreme emphasis on individualism and freedom of choice.
solidarity.translationZh: 团结也被视为是对极度强调个人主义和选择自由的一种回应。
solidarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

solidarity.sentenceEn: In this increasingly diverse society we live in, solidarity takes on a complex and multifaceted character as it forms bonds of interdependence among unique individuals living in a fast-changing environment and working within a complex division of labor.
solidarity.translationZh: 在我们生活的这个日益多元化的社会中，团结呈现出一种复杂且多维的特征，它在快速变化的环境中以及复杂的社会分工背景下，将独特的个体联系在一起，形成相互依存的纽带。
solidarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

solidarity.sentenceEn: Solidarity is not just a product of strategic calculations of how much it will benefit the self.
solidarity.translationZh: 团结不仅仅是基于个人利益能获得多少的战略计算产物。
solidarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

solidarity.sentenceEn: One facet of solidarity fits well with the principles of communitarianism(社群主义).
solidarity.translationZh: 团结的一个方面与社群主义的原则非常契合。
solidarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

solidarity.sentenceEn: What does solidarity entail according to the passage?
solidarity.translationZh: 根据文章内容，团结的具体含义是什么？

stimulate.sentenceEn: The preserve is rich with history, culture, biodiversity, and endless opportunities to stimulate your interest, especially for anyone who loves the outdoors.
stimulate.translationZh: 这片保护区蕴含着丰富的历史、文化和生物多样性，同时也为游客提供了无尽的探索乐趣，尤其适合热爱户外的人士。
stimulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

stimulate.sentenceEn: This excitement makes pursuing goals enjoyable and stimulates pleasure and pride that would result from success.
stimulate.translationZh: 这种兴奋感让追求目标的过程变得令人愉悦，并激发了成功后将会产生的愉悦感和自豪感。
stimulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

stimulate.sentenceEn: Some people in the US have asserted that forgiving student loan debt is one way to stimulate the economy and give assistance to those in need.
stimulate.translationZh: 美国一些人声称，免除学生贷款债务是刺激经济和帮助有需要的人的一种方式。
stimulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

stimulate.sentenceEn: Grazing herds stimulate microbial activity in the soil, helping to capture water and separate carbon.
stimulate.translationZh: 放牧的牛群能刺激土壤中的微生物活动，有助于涵养水分和固碳。

stimulate.sentenceEn: Acupuncture points are stimulated to balance the circulation of qi.
stimulate.translationZh: 刺激穴位是为了平衡气血运行。
stimulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第10句

stimulate.sentenceEn: Stimulate them to embrace fresh opportunities.

surround.sentenceEn: Also, humans are such absorbent social beings that when we surround ourselves with others, we automatically take in their opinions and aesthetics.
surround.translationZh: 此外，人类是极具感染力的社会性生物，当我们身处人群中时，会不由自主地接纳他人的观点和审美。

surround.sentenceEn: At the end of the day, I've always been surrounded by a positive environment conducive to my working hard and pursuing my dreams.
surround.translationZh: 归根结底，我身边始终围绕着积极向上的环境，激励我勤奋工作、追逐梦想。
surround.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

surround.sentenceEn: The city also needs to update existing transportation routes combined with smart home-building policies that dramatically increase housing density in areas surrounding high-speed rail stations.
surround.translationZh: 旧金山市还需要更新现有的交通线路，同时实施明智的住房建设政策，大幅提高高铁站周边区域的住房密度。

surround.sentenceEn: The region is surrounded by water and mountains.
surround.translationZh: 该地区被水和山脉环绕。

surround.sentenceEn: We create and surround ourselves with things that have never existed before, while animals do not.
surround.translationZh: 我们创造并让自己置身于前所未有的事物之中，而动物则不会这样做。
surround.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

surround.sentenceEn: In the majority of cases we would be better off identifying people by the factors that constrain their lives, like income, rather than by the lines surrounding them on a map.
surround.translationZh: 在大多数情况下，我们最好通过那些制约人们生活的因素（如收入）来界定人群，而非地图上划分他们的那些线条。
surround.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

severe.sentenceEn: But these are severe and involuntary cases of aloneness.
severe.translationZh: 但这些是严重且非自愿的孤独情况。

severe.sentenceEn: The restaurant industry is currently suffering a severe shortage of skilled chefs — a deficit of 11,000, according to the skills agency People 1st.
severe.translationZh: 餐饮业目前正面临着熟练厨师严重短缺的问题——根据技能评估机构 People 1st 的数据，这一缺口已达 1.1 万人。

severe.sentenceEn: Finally, on October 9, 1942, the over 30 meter tall and 200-400 year old tree fell, rumor has it, as a result of a severe windstorm and/or via having previously died and its roots rotted.
severe.translationZh: 最终，在1942年10月9日，这棵高达30多米、树龄200-400年的古树倒下了。据传，其原因可能是一场强烈的风暴，也可能是树木先前已经枯死，根部腐烂所致。

severe.sentenceEn: But repeating that accomplishment is often not realistic, which can lead to severe negative emotional consequences when it doesn't reoccur.
severe.translationZh: 但重复那种成就往往不切实际，当无法再次实现时，可能会导致严重的负面情绪后果。
severe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

severe.sentenceEn: One thought leader in the positive stress world is Dutch extreme athlete Wim Hof, who earned the name "ice man" for his ability to withstand severe cold using deep breathing exercises.
severe.translationZh: 积极压力领域的一位思想领袖是荷兰极限运动员维姆·霍夫，他因能通过深呼吸练习抵御严寒而获得了“冰人”的称号。
severe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

severe.sentenceEn: Provide loans to those in severe financial difficulty.
severe.translationZh: 为那些陷入严重财务困境的人提供贷款

similarly.sentenceEn: Similarly , if you're looking for love advice, ask someone removed from the ups and downs of your relationship instead of relying only on your best friend.
similarly.translationZh: 同样，如果你在寻求情感建议，与其只依赖最好的朋友，不如去请教那些置身于你的感情波动之外的人。

similarly.sentenceEn: Flashing Red Arrows similarly mean to stop and then proceed to take the turn.
similarly.translationZh: 红色闪烁箭头同样表示先停车，然后在确保安全的情况下转弯。

similarly.sentenceEn: The achievability of universal 100% renewability is similarly contentious.
similarly.translationZh: 实现全球100%可再生能源的可行性同样存在争议。
similarly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

similarly.sentenceEn: Similarly , an occasional dash of sarcastic wit can spice up a chat and add an element of humor to it.
similarly.translationZh: 同样，偶尔的一丝讽刺意味的机智言辞能为聊天增添趣味，注入幽默元素。
similarly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

similarly.sentenceEn: Similarly , grateful people may be more likely to reciprocate(回报) with acts of kindness of their own.
similarly.translationZh: 同样，心怀感恩的人更有可能以自身的善举来回报他人。

similarly.sentenceEn: It behaves similarly to animals capable of self-recognition.
similarly.translationZh: 它的表现与那些具有自我认知能力的动物相似。

snack.sentenceEn: Ultra-processed foods are characteristically designed to be cheap, tasty, and convenient; examples include soft drinks and candy, packaged snacks and pastries, ready-to-heat products, and reconstituted meat products.
snack.translationZh: 超加工食品的特点是价格低廉、味道鲜美且食用方便；例如软饮料、糖果、包装零食、糕点、即热食品和重组肉制品。
snack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

snack.sentenceEn: In recent years she has used some of the forgotten crops grown at CFF, such as moringa and bambara groundnut, to make everything from instant soup to Indian snacks .
snack.translationZh: 近年来，她利用了一些在CFF种植的被遗忘作物，如辣木和班巴拉花生，制作从速食汤到印度小吃等各种食品。

snack.sentenceEn: Berries and nuts are a convenient and nutritious snack .
snack.translationZh: 浆果和坚果是一种方便又营养的零食。
snack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

snack.sentenceEn: If you're someone who has turned to snacking on junk food more in the pandemic(大流行病), you're not alone.
snack.translationZh: 如果你是在疫情期间更多地转向吃垃圾食品零食的人，那么你并不孤单。
snack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

snack.sentenceEn: Moss examines the way companies capitalize on our memories, cravings and brain chemistry to keep us snacking .
snack.translationZh: 莫斯研究了食品公司如何利用我们的记忆、渴望和大脑化学反应来让我们持续吃零食。
snack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

snack.sentenceEn: A snack bar producer discovered that the supply of purely grass-fed bison meat was scarce.
snack.translationZh: 一家零食棒生产商发现纯草饲野牛肉的供应十分短缺。

spectrum.sentenceEn: I like to merge styles that are often at opposite ends of the fashion spectrum .
spectrum.translationZh: 我喜欢融合那些通常处于时尚光谱两端的风格。
spectrum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

spectrum.sentenceEn: There will likely be a spectrum .
spectrum.translationZh: 很可能存在一个分布范围。
spectrum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

spectrum.sentenceEn: In fact, there has never been a single standard that's been fully agreed upon — and broadcast outlets across the spectrum have never consistently held to those standards anyway.
spectrum.translationZh: 事实上，从来没有一个完全一致的统一标准——而且无论如何，各行各业的广播机构也从未始终如一地遵守过这些标准。
spectrum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

spectrum.sentenceEn: Rainbows present a spectrum made up of seven colors in a specific order.
spectrum.translationZh: 彩虹呈现出由七种颜色按特定顺序组成的光谱。
spectrum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

spectrum.sentenceEn: At the other end of the spectrum is a handful of colleges that have fewer than a hundred students on campus and no online courses: colleges such as Sterling College, Thomas More College of Liberal Arts, and Deep Springs College.
spectrum.translationZh: 而处于另一极端的是少数几所大学，它们的在校学生不足百人，也不提供在线课程：比如斯特林学院、托马斯·莫尔文理学院和深泉学院。

spectrum.sentenceEn: However, the reality is that, across the spectrum of human activities, prior work propels the creative process.
spectrum.translationZh: 然而，现实情况是，在人类活动的各个领域，前人的成果都在推动着创造过程。
spectrum.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

subway.sentenceEn: Take a close look next time you're in Boston, and here are some of the things you'll probably see: people smoking in the subway stations despite the frequent reminders not to do so; pedestrians walking when the crosswalk lights say not to do so, ignoring the cars; car drivers speeding, making a loud noise with the horn and occasionally cursing at each other.
subway.translationZh: 下次你在波士顿时仔细观察，可能会发现这些现象：人们无视频繁的警示在地铁站吸烟；行人不顾交通信号灯和车辆，闯红灯过马路；汽车司机超速行驶，按喇叭制造噪音，偶尔还会互相咒骂。
subway.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

subway.sentenceEn: There, the city is trying to persuade subway riders to be more considerate.
subway.translationZh: 在那里，该市正努力劝导地铁乘客更加体谅他人。
subway.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

subway.sentenceEn: The Glasgow subway first opened in 1896 as a cable-hauled system.
subway.translationZh: 格拉斯哥地铁于1896年首次开通时为缆索牵引系统。
subway.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

subway.sentenceEn: Since its launch, the technology has been adopted by more than 100,000 subway customers.
subway.translationZh: 自推出以来，该技术已被超过10万名地铁乘客采用。
subway.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

subway.sentenceEn: As a result, the subway saw a rapid decline in ridership.
subway.translationZh: 因此，地铁的客流量迅速下降。
subway.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

subway.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about the Glasgow subway in the 1960s?
subway.translationZh: 关于格拉斯哥地铁在20世纪60年代的情况，文章说了什么？

suit.sentenceEn: Hence, the sparkling cape was paired with a traditional power suit you would typically see in a business setting.
suit.translationZh: 因此，这件闪亮的披风搭配了一套传统的权力套装，这种套装在商务场合中极为常见。
suit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

suit.sentenceEn: If all that's on the agenda is a quick catch-up, or some non-urgent information sharing, it may better suit the group to send around an email instead.
suit.translationZh: 如果议程上只有简短的近况交流，或是一些非紧急的信息分享，那么发一封邮件给大家可能更合适。

suit.sentenceEn: Once the desired beauty ideal has been internalized, users are given tools or features to change their appearance to suit the accepted beauty ideal such as editing the image, choosing the ideal filter, the right background.
suit.translationZh: 一旦用户将理想的 beauty 标准内化，系统就会提供工具或功能让他们调整自己的外貌以符合公认的 beauty 标准，例如编辑图片、选择理想滤镜和合适的背景。
suit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

suit.sentenceEn: Academic research and job training are important, but tiny colleges aren't suited for either.
suit.translationZh: 学术研究和职业培训固然重要，但小型学院并不适合开展这两项工作。

suit.sentenceEn: when one person starts checking their phone, the others will follow suit .
suit.translationZh: 一旦有人开始查看手机，其他人就会跟风效仿。

suit.sentenceEn: Draw intricate patterns onto a traditional power suit .
suit.translationZh: 在传统西装上绘制精致复杂的图案。

suitable.sentenceEn: Meat is more calorie-dense per serving than vegetarian options, and ruminant animals largely thrive on feed that is not suitable for humans.
suitable.translationZh: 每份肉类比素食选项的热量密度更高，而反刍动物主要以不适合人类食用的饲料为生。

suitable.sentenceEn: It's a very versatile space, suitable both for eating and relaxing.
suitable.translationZh: 这是一个非常多功能的空间，既适合用餐，也适合放松。
suitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

suitable.sentenceEn: About 40% of the land now used to grow maize(玉米) would no longer be suitable for it.
suitable.translationZh: 目前约40%用于种植玉米的土地将不再适合玉米生长。

suitable.sentenceEn: W: Well, I sell specialty clothes through a website, mainly for women who have trouble finding suitable clothes in main street shops because of their height or weight.
suitable.translationZh: 女：我通过网站销售特色服装，主要面向那些因身高或体重问题，在普通商店难以找到合适衣服的女性。
suitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

suitable.sentenceEn: More than half of the world's farmland is suitable only for animals like cows to graze on.
suitable.translationZh: 世界上超过一半的农田只适合牛等动物放牧。

suitable.sentenceEn: They are more suitable to young people.

super.sentenceEn: The space agency was primarily concerned about keeping the air fresh for astronauts cut off in biospheres or space stations and helping to combat "sick building syndrome", which had become a problem due to the super insulated and energy efficient offices of the late 1970s.
super.translationZh: 航天局最初主要关注的是为与世隔绝的生物圈或空间站中的宇航员保持空气清新，以及帮助解决20世纪70年代末因超隔热、节能办公室而出现的"病态建筑综合症"问题。
super.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

super.sentenceEn: You may have heard that the super special second blue moon of 2018 was also a Paschal moon.
super.translationZh: 你可能听说过，2018年那个特别的第二个蓝月亮同时也是一个逾越节月亮。

super.sentenceEn: The reason you care about this ordinary change in distance is that it turns a moon super .
super.translationZh: 你之所以在意这种普通的距离变化，是因为它会使月亮变成超级月亮。

super.sentenceEn: We get these super lunar events by smashing together all the qualifiers we've historically used to keep track of full moons throughout the year, and in the age of the internet we can get a little too enthusiastic.
super.translationZh: 我们将历史上用来记录全年满月的各种限定词拼凑在一起，就有了这些超级月亮现象；而在互联网时代，我们对此可能有些过于热衷了。

super.sentenceEn: There is nothing unusual about the super blood wolf moon, which will bear no resemblance to a bloody wolf head.
super.translationZh: 超级血狼月并没有什么特别之处，它完全不会像一个血淋淋的狼头。

super.sentenceEn: NASA did experiments in sealed containers resembling the super insulated offices of 1970s.
super.translationZh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）在密封容器中进行了实验，这些容器类似于20世纪70年代的超级隔热办公室。

supposed.sentenceEn: Timed traffic lights are set according to schedules that are supposed to coordinate with peak traffic hours.
supposed.translationZh: 定时红绿灯是根据旨在配合交通高峰时段的时间表来设置的。

supposed.sentenceEn: One reason linguists agree there is no one true standard is that, through the years, there have been multiple supposed standards, depending on time and place.
supposed.translationZh: 语言学家们一致认为不存在唯一的标准，原因之一在于，受时代和地域影响，历史上曾出现过多种所谓的标准。
supposed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

supposed.sentenceEn: At the same time, a group of influencers have begun to upload to social media photos of themselves without makeup, and even photos in which they highlight supposed flaws.
supposed.translationZh: 与此同时，一群网红开始在社交媒体上上传自己的素颜照，甚至还发布刻意突出所谓“瑕疵”的照片。
supposed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

supposed.sentenceEn: "When it is supposed to rain it doesn't, then it all comes at once."
supposed.translationZh: 该下雨的时候不下，一下就下得倾盆而下。

supposed.sentenceEn: But in developing countries, the path of future development has more potential to change, which has encouraged international institutions to devise more sustainable growth pathways that are supposed both to alleviate poverty and preserve the environment.
supposed.translationZh: 但在发展中国家，未来发展道路的改变潜力更大，这促使国际机构设计出更可持续的增长路径，旨在既能缓解贫困，又能保护环境。
supposed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

supposed.sentenceEn: What is a manager supposed to do to enable workers to do a better job?
supposed.translationZh: 管理者应该做些什么才能让员工把工作做得更好？

symptom.sentenceEn: Individuals who regularly engage in gratitude exercises, such as counting their blessings or expressing gratitude to others, exhibit increased satisfaction with relationships and fewer symptoms of physical illness.
symptom.translationZh: 经常进行感恩练习的人，比如细数自己的福气或向他人表达感谢，对人际关系的满意度会更高，身体疾病的症状也会更少。

symptom.sentenceEn: The researchers found that writing as few as three weekly thank-you notes over the course of three weeks improved life satisfaction, increased happy feelings and reduced symptoms of depression.
symptom.translationZh: 研究人员发现，在三周时间内，每周仅需写三封感谢信，就能提高生活满意度，增强幸福感，并减轻抑郁症状。

symptom.sentenceEn: A separate study, conducted in India, found strikingly similar results: bilingual patients developed symptoms of dementia 4.5 years later than monolinguals, even after other potential factors, such as gender and occupation, were controlled for.
symptom.translationZh: 在印度进行的另一项研究发现了惊人相似的结果：双语患者的痴呆症状比单语患者晚出现4.5年，即便在控制了性别和职业等其他潜在因素后亦是如此。

symptom.sentenceEn: It's even relatively easy to fool lie detectors, the gold standard of lie detection, by training yourself in breathing techniques and symptom suppression.
symptom.translationZh: 通过训练自己掌握呼吸技巧和症状抑制方法，甚至相对容易骗过测谎仪——这种测谎领域的黄金标准。
symptom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

symptom.sentenceEn: According to the speaker, what might be a symptom of cognitive decline in older adults?
symptom.translationZh: 根据讲话者所说，老年人认知衰退的症状可能是什么？

symptom.sentenceEn: She found some symptoms of her illness gone.
symptom.translationZh: 她发现自己疾病的一些症状消失了。

scent.sentenceEn: That results in an intimate connection between emotions, memories and scents , which is why memories triggered by scents are experienced as more emotional than those triggered by sight or sound.
scent.translationZh: 这使得情绪、记忆与气味之间形成了一种密切的联系，这也是为什么由气味触发的记忆往往比由视觉或声音触发的记忆更具情感色彩。
scent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

scent.sentenceEn: The special nature of memories brought back by scents notwithstanding, they have the same drawbacks as other memories.
scent.translationZh: 尽管气味唤起的记忆具有特殊性，但它们与其他记忆有着相同的缺点。
scent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

scent.sentenceEn: Imagine this scenario—a person is walking down the street smelling a scent that they first encountered decades ago, which activates an emotional response.
scent.translationZh: 想象这样一个场景：一个人走在街上，闻到了几十年前首次闻到的一种气味，这引发了一种情感反应。
scent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

scent.sentenceEn: A scent is a chemical particle that floats in through the nose and into the region of the brain responsible for smell, where the sensation is first processed into a form that the brain can read.
scent.translationZh: 气味是一种化学微粒，它通过鼻子进入大脑中负责嗅觉的区域，在那里，这种感觉首先被处理成大脑能够识别的形式。
scent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

scent.sentenceEn: But, because of the strong emotional associations these memories evoke, people who remember something due to a scent are often convinced that the memories are accurate, even when they aren't.
scent.translationZh: 但是，由于这些记忆会唤起强烈的情感联想，那些因气味而记起某事的人往往坚信这些记忆是准确的，即便事实并非如此。
scent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

scent.sentenceEn: What is said to result in an intimate connection between emotions, memories and scents ?
scent.translationZh: 据说是什么导致了情感、记忆和气味之间的密切联系？

section.sentenceEn: Sections 4, 5, 8 and 9 still have to be aligned to the new framework.
section.translationZh: 第 4、5、8 和 9 章节仍需与新框架保持一致。
section.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

section.sentenceEn: Placing vegetarian dishes in a separate section did not have a significant effect on the choices made by infrequent vegetarian food eaters.
section.translationZh: 将素食菜肴单独分出一栏，对那些不常吃素的人群的选择没有显著影响。
section.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

section.sentenceEn: Although it sounds counter-intuitive, restaurants which include specific vegetarian sections on their menus may be unintentionally encouraging customers to eat meat, a new study suggests.
section.translationZh: 一项新研究表明，尽管听起来有悖常理，但在菜单上专门设立素食区的餐厅，可能会在无意中促使顾客选择吃肉。
section.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

section.sentenceEn: I thought that's surely something we should have covered earlier in the section discussing strengths and talents, but no.
section.translationZh: 我本以为这在之前讨论优势和才能的环节就应该提到了，结果并没有。
section.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

section.sentenceEn: Even within a single field, conditions are always changing from one section to the next.
section.translationZh: 即使在同一片田地中，各个区域的条件也总是在变化。

section.sentenceEn: What does a new study suggest about restaurants including vegetarian sections on their menus?
section.translationZh: 一项新研究对餐厅在菜单中加入素食专区有什么看法？

seemingly.sentenceEn: The tardigrade's indestructibility stems from its adaptations to its environment—which may seem surprising, since it lives in seemingly comfortable places, like the cool, wet patches of moss(青苔) that dot a garden wall.
seemingly.translationZh: 缓步动物（水熊虫）的不可摧毁性源于其对环境的适应性——这似乎有些令人惊讶，因为它生活在看似舒适的地方，比如点缀在花园墙壁上的凉爽湿润的青苔丛。
seemingly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

seemingly.sentenceEn: But according to the 'Mr. Miyagi principle', practising seemingly unrelated skills may actually benefit learning of other skills.
seemingly.translationZh: 但根据'宫城先生原则'，练习看似不相关的技能实际上可能有助于学习其他技能。
seemingly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

seemingly.sentenceEn: They can hit fastballs coming at them at nearly 100 miles an hour, and leap and hang in the air, seemingly defying gravity.
seemingly.translationZh: 他们能击中以近每小时100英里的速度飞来的快球，还能纵身跃起并在空中停留，仿佛在挑战地心引力。
seemingly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

seemingly.sentenceEn: Where does the seemingly irrational human preference for over-imitation come from?
seemingly.translationZh: 人类这种看似非理性的过度模仿倾向从何而来？
seemingly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

seemingly.sentenceEn: Recent history shows reduction of pollution, once seemingly impossible, can actually be accomplished.
seemingly.translationZh: 近代历史表明，曾经看似不可能的污染减排实际上是可以实现的。

seemingly.sentenceEn: Use the principle of variability in teaching seemingly unrelated skills in education.
seemingly.translationZh: 在教育中运用可变性原则教授看似不相关的技能。

substance.sentenceEn: The system defines ultra-processed foods as those made using sequences of processes that extract substances from foods and alter them with chemicals in order to formulate the final product.
substance.translationZh: 该系统将超加工食品定义为：通过一系列加工过程从食物中提取物质，并使用化学物质对其进行改造以形成最终产品的食品。
substance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

substance.sentenceEn: Toxic substances like mercury leak into soil and groundwater and disperse in the air.
substance.translationZh: 汞等有毒物质会渗入土壤和地下水，并扩散到空气中。
substance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

substance.sentenceEn: Investigative reporter Michael Moss says processed food is engineered to hook you, not unlike alcohol, cigarettes, or other harmful substances .
substance.translationZh: 调查记者迈克尔·莫斯表示，加工食品经过精心设计，旨在让你上钩，这与酒精、香烟或其他有害物质并无二致。
substance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

substance.sentenceEn: One of the features of addiction that scientists studying drug addiction discovered back in the 1990s was that the faster a substance hits the brain, the more apt we are as a result to act impulsively.
substance.translationZh: 20世纪90年代，研究药物成瘾的科学家发现，成瘾的一个特征是：一种物质作用于大脑的速度越快，我们就越容易冲动行事。
substance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

substance.sentenceEn: They take over protective functions against soil erosion and landslides(塌方); they make a significant contribution to the water balance as they prevent surface runoff; they filter dirt particles, greenhouse gases and radioactive substances from the air; they produce oxygen; they provide spaces for recreation and they preserve historic and prehistoric remains.
substance.translationZh: 它们承担着防止水土流失和塌方的保护功能；它们通过防止地表径流对水平衡做出重要贡献；它们过滤空气中的尘埃颗粒、温室气体和放射性物质；它们产生氧气；它们提供休闲空间并保护历史和史前遗迹。

substance.sentenceEn: Substitute all toxic substances with non-toxic ones.
substance.translationZh: 用无毒物质替代所有有毒物质。

substitute.sentenceEn: For example, if you want to stop checking your email first thing in the morning, you might decide to substitute another activity in its place.
substitute.translationZh: 例如，如果你想不再把早上第一件事就查看邮件，你可以决定用另一项活动来替代它。

substitute.sentenceEn: We see the emergence of machines as substitute judges in a variety of everyday contexts as a potential threat to people learning how to effectively exercise judgment themselves.
substitute.translationZh: 我们注意到，在各种日常场景中，机器正逐渐成为替代人类进行判断的角色，这可能会阻碍人们学习如何有效运用自身判断力。
substitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

substitute.sentenceEn: In fact, some of the companies are now exploring a leather substitute and a silk replacement made from mushrooms.
substitute.translationZh: 事实上，部分企业现正研发以蘑菇为原料的皮革替代品和丝绸替代物。
substitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

substitute.sentenceEn: Texas passed a bill in 2013 that allows students to substitute computer coding only after they have attempted and performed poorly in a foreign language class.
substitute.translationZh: 德克萨斯州于2013年通过一项法案，允许学生只有在尝试学习外语课程但表现不佳后，才能用计算机编程课替代外语课。

substitute.sentenceEn: Sometimes, it may not be successful to simply substitute one activity with another to effect a change of habit; you may need extra reinforcement.
substitute.translationZh: 有时候，仅仅用一项活动替代另一项活动来改变习惯可能不会成功；你可能需要额外的强化措施。

substitute.sentenceEn: Substitute all toxic substances with non-toxic ones.
substitute.translationZh: 用无毒物质替代所有有毒物质。

sustain.sentenceEn: They assert that although doing some work might be necessary, meaning, purpose and social value reside in the communities and relationships built and sustained outside of the workplace.
sustain.translationZh: 他们认为，尽管从事一些工作可能是必要的，但生活的意义、目标和社会价值存在于工作场所以外建立和维系的社区与人际关系中。
sustain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

sustain.sentenceEn: Because we are creatures of habit, it's natural to assume that when we do manage to adopt and sustain a desirable behavior, that same strategy will work when we want to make another behavior change.
sustain.translationZh: 因为我们是习惯的产物，所以很自然地会认为，当我们成功养成并维持一种理想行为时，同样的策略也适用于我们想要做出的其他行为改变。

sustain.sentenceEn: The research on whether we have finite or infinite willpower is inconclusive, but experts do generally agree that you can't change and sustain a habit if you rely on your willpower alone.
sustain.translationZh: 关于我们的意志力是有限还是无限的研究尚无定论，但专家们普遍认为，如果你仅依靠意志力，就无法改变并维持一个习惯。

sustain.sentenceEn: That's why, when determining how to create a better work-life balance, we need to consider not only how to balance work and family demands, but also how to cultivate and sustain supportive friendships.
sustain.translationZh: 因此，在思考如何更好地平衡工作与生活时，我们不仅要考虑如何协调工作与家庭的需求，还应思考如何培养和维系有益的友谊。
sustain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

sustain.sentenceEn: Our research suggests that global winners typically create and sustain their international presence through a systematic process of exploiting, renewing and enhancing their core capabilities.
sustain.translationZh: 我们的研究表明，全球赢家通常通过系统性地利用、更新和增强其核心能力来建立并维持其国际影响力。
sustain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

sustain.sentenceEn: Balanced literacy fails to sustain children's interest in developing a good reading habit.
sustain.translationZh: 平衡读写教学法无法维持儿童培养良好阅读习惯的兴趣。

syndrome.sentenceEn: The space agency was primarily concerned about keeping the air fresh for astronauts cut off in biospheres or space stations and helping to combat "sick building syndrome ", which had become a problem due to the super insulated and energy efficient offices of the late 1970s.
syndrome.translationZh: 航天局最初主要关注的是为与世隔绝的生物圈或空间站中的宇航员保持空气清新，以及帮助解决20世纪70年代末因超隔热、节能办公室而出现的"病态建筑综合症"问题。
syndrome.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

syndrome.sentenceEn: Meeting recovery syndrome is a concept that should be familiar to almost anyone who has held a formal job.
syndrome.translationZh: 会议恢复期综合征是几乎所有有过正式工作经历的人都应该熟悉的概念。

syndrome.sentenceEn: If you run to the office kitchen to get some relief with colleagues after a frustrating meeting, you're likely experiencing meeting recovery syndrome .
syndrome.translationZh: 如果一场令人沮丧的会议后，你跑到办公室厨房和同事们一起放松一下，那么你很可能正在经历会议恢复综合征。

syndrome.sentenceEn: The result is not only hundreds of billions of wasted dollars, but an annoyance of what organisational psychologists call "meeting recovery syndrome (MRS)": time spent cooling off and regaining focus after a useless meeting.
syndrome.translationZh: 其结果不仅是数千亿美元的资金浪费，还会引发组织心理学家所说的“会议恢复综合症(MRS)”：在一场无用的会议后，人们需要时间冷静下来并重新集中注意力。

syndrome.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about Foreign Accent Syndrome ?
syndrome.translationZh: 关于外国口音综合征，这篇文章说了什么？

syndrome.sentenceEn: Blame your worthless workdays on meeting recovery syndrome
syndrome.translationZh: 把你毫无价值的工作日归咎于会议恢复期综合征

sanctuary.sentenceEn: Since national parks are wildlife sanctuaries where no disturbance of the native animals is allowed, years of protection have served to break down the wild bears' fear of humans.
sanctuary.translationZh: 由于国家公园是野生动物保护区，不允许干扰本土动物，多年的保护使得野生熊对人类的恐惧逐渐消失。
sanctuary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sanctuary.sentenceEn: A global campaign has been launched to turn a huge tract of Antarctic seas into ocean sanctuaries protecting wildlife and banning not just krill fishing, but all fishing.
sanctuary.translationZh: 一项全球性运动已启动，旨在将南极海域的大片区域划为海洋保护区，以保护野生动物，不仅禁止磷虾捕捞，还将全面禁止所有渔业活动。
sanctuary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

sanctuary.sentenceEn: Frida Bengtsson from Greenpeace's Protect the Antarctic campaign said: "If the krill industry wants to show it's a responsible player, then it should be voluntarily getting out of any area which is being proposed as an ocean sanctuary , and should instead be backing the protection of these huge tracts of the Antarctic."
sanctuary.translationZh: 绿色和平组织“保护南极”运动的弗里达·本特松说：“如果磷虾产业想证明自己是负责任的参与者，那么它就应该主动退出任何拟议设立为海洋保护区的区域，转而支持对南极这些广阔区域的保护。”
sanctuary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

sanctuary.sentenceEn: It will decide on the Weddell Sea sanctuary proposal at a conference in Australia in October, although a decision on the peninsula sanctuary is not expected until later.
sanctuary.translationZh: 该委员会将于10月在澳大利亚召开的会议上对威德尔海保护区提案作出决定，而关于南极半岛保护区的决定预计将推迟至更晚时候。
sanctuary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

sanctuary.sentenceEn: A global campaign has been launched to create a network of ocean sanctuaries to protect the seas in the region and Greenpeace is calling for an immediate halt to fishing in areas being considered for sanctuary status.
sanctuary.translationZh: 目前已发起一项全球性运动，旨在建立海洋保护区网络以保护该地区的海洋环境。绿色和平组织呼吁立即停止在那些正在考虑设立为保护区的海域进行捕捞活动。
sanctuary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

sanctuary.sentenceEn: Efforts to create one of the world's largest ocean sanctuaries failed because of Russia's obstruction.
sanctuary.translationZh: 由于俄罗斯的阻挠，建立世界上最大海洋保护区之一的努力以失败告终。

scheme.sentenceEn: Although many such monitoring schemes use anonymised data and participation is voluntary, many staffers remain sceptical and fear an erosion of their civil liberties.
scheme.translationZh: 尽管许多此类监控方案使用匿名数据且参与是自愿的，但不少员工仍持怀疑态度，并担心其公民自由受到侵蚀。
scheme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

scheme.sentenceEn: As long as such schemes are voluntary, there will probably be a growing number of convenience-oriented uses so that a substantial number of workers would opt to have a chip inserted.
scheme.translationZh: 只要这类方案是自愿参与的，就可能会出现越来越多以便利为导向的应用，从而使相当一部分员工选择植入芯片。
scheme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

scheme.sentenceEn: To commemorate this special event, the colour scheme of the train carriages was updated.
scheme.translationZh: 为纪念这一特殊时刻，地铁车厢的配色方案进行了更新。
scheme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

scheme.sentenceEn: While these are honorable schemes , it makes it harder for Burberry to defend these latest figures.
scheme.translationZh: 尽管这些计划值得称道，但却让博柏利更难对最新数据做出合理解释。

scheme.sentenceEn: But the scheme is attracting criticism from scientists and conservation groups, who argue that the government hasn't gone far enough in protecting the Coral Sea, or in other marine reserves in the coastal network.
scheme.translationZh: 但该计划正招致科学家和环保组织的批评，他们认为政府在保护珊瑚海以及海岸网络中的其他海洋保护区方面做得还远远不够。
scheme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

scheme.sentenceEn: What does the speaker mean by the Work Sharing scheme ?
scheme.translationZh: 发言者所说的“工作共享”计划是什么意思？

selection.sentenceEn: In my view, there are many reasons for either choosing animal protein or opting for a vegetarian selection .
selection.translationZh: 在我看来，选择动物蛋白或素食有诸多原因。

selection.sentenceEn: At the same time, though, this selection is optimizing for what people are likely to prefer based on what they've preferred in the past.
selection.translationZh: 然而，与此同时，这种选择是基于人们过去的偏好来优化他们可能喜欢的内容。
selection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

selection.sentenceEn: This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held, reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work, The Origin of Species, which established the doctrine of natural selection .
selection.translationZh: 这种前理性世界的图景仍然被广泛接受，查尔斯·达尔文极具影响力的著作《物种起源》进一步强化了这一观点，该书确立了自然选择学说。
selection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

selection.sentenceEn: As it has often been pointed out, however, there is nothing in the concept of natural selection that suggests that competition is the most successful strategy for "survival of the fittest."
selection.translationZh: 然而，正如人们常指出的那样，自然选择的概念中并没有任何内容表明竞争是“适者生存”的最成功策略。
selection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

selection.sentenceEn: It feels morally questionable, yet claims of genetic selection by intelligence are making headlines.
selection.translationZh: 这在道德上令人质疑，但有关通过智力进行基因选择的说法却成了头条新闻。
selection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

selection.sentenceEn: The strongest species proves to be the fittest in natural selection .
selection.translationZh: 在自然选择中，最强大的物种被证明是最适者。

sharply.sentenceEn: It's frequently noted that fertility rates are falling sharply in richer countries.
sharply.translationZh: 人们常注意到，富裕国家的生育率正在急剧下降。
sharply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sharply.sentenceEn: It was intended to sharply reduce the amount of time that English-language learners spent in bilingual settings.
sharply.translationZh: 该提案旨在大幅缩短英语学习者在双语环境中的学习时间。
零售业利润正急剧下滑。

sharply.sentenceEn: However, as the cost of getting your own satellite in orbit drops sharply , the risks of irresponsible use grow.
sharply.translationZh: 然而，随着将个人卫星送入轨道的成本急剧下降，不负责任使用卫星的风险也在增加。

sharply.sentenceEn: In fact, in line with past experience, capital expenditure in the oil sector has dropped sharply in many producing countries, including the United States.
sharply.translationZh: 事实上，与以往经验一致，包括美国在内的许多产油国的石油行业资本支出已大幅下降。

sharply.sentenceEn: The fertility rates in America have in fact been falling sharply .
sharply.translationZh: 事实上，美国的生育率一直在急剧下降。

slip.sentenceEn: Women who have children begin to see their salaries slip behind their male counterparts.
slip.translationZh: 生育子女的女性开始发现自己的薪资落后于男性同行。
slip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

slip.sentenceEn: The fourth one to avoid is not forgiving ourselves for slipping up.
slip.translationZh: 需要避免的第四点是不要因为失误而不原谅自己。

slip.sentenceEn: When the moon slips through our shadow, we give it a reddish coloring.
slip.translationZh: 当月亮穿过我们的阴影时，我们给它染上红色。

slip.sentenceEn: In one case in 2005, police arrested four fountain cleaners after they were spotted slipping coins into their own pockets after collecting them.
slip.translationZh: 2005年曾发生一起案件，四名喷泉清洁工在收集硬币后被发现将其私自揣入腰包，随后被警方逮捕。
slip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

slip.sentenceEn: What partly accounts for the slip in women's salaries?
slip.translationZh: 女性薪资下滑的部分原因是什么？

slip.sentenceEn: He slipped on ice and fell.

slowly.sentenceEn: If the system moves too slowly , the bags won't make connecting flights.
slowly.translationZh: 如果系统运行太慢，行李将无法赶上中转航班。
slowly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

slowly.sentenceEn: Like all deserts, though, if you are patient, you will be rewarded, as they often reveal their secrets slowly .
slowly.translationZh: 不过，如同所有沙漠一样，只要你有耐心，就一定会有所收获，因为它们总是会慢慢揭开自己的神秘面纱。
slowly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

slowly.sentenceEn: For all the fuss made about top speeds, cornering ability and acceleration, the most useful gadgets on a modern car are those which work when you're going very slowly : parking sensors, sound systems, and navigation apps which will show a way around upcoming traffic jams.
slowly.translationZh: 尽管人们对汽车的最高速度、转弯性能和加速能力大肆吹嘘，但现代汽车上最有用的装置却是那些在车速很慢时派上用场的设备：泊车传感器、音响系统，以及能指引绕过前方交通拥堵的导航应用。
slowly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

slowly.sentenceEn: Piaget and his followers maintained that children go through something like a dark age of intellectual development before slowly and gradually becoming enlightened by reason and rationality as they reach school age.
slowly.translationZh: 皮亚杰及其追随者认为，儿童在进入学龄期前会经历一个类似智力发展"黑暗时代"的阶段，之后才会慢慢被理性和理智所启蒙。

slowly.sentenceEn: Instead of one big narrative, a story of unexpected rescue by a larger-than-life hero, we need multiple stories: we need stories, not only of what Rob Nixon of Princeton University has called the 'slow violence' of environmental degradation (that is, the damage that is often invisible at first and develops slowly and gradually), but also stories of what I call 'slow hope'.
slowly.translationZh: 我们需要的不是单一宏大的叙事——一个由传奇英雄意外拯救世界的故事，而是多元的故事：我们不仅需要普林斯顿大学的罗布·尼克松所说的环境恶化带来的“缓慢暴力”（即那种最初往往难以察觉、却在缓慢中逐渐加剧的破坏）的故事，也需要我所说的“缓慢希望”的故事。

socioeconomic.sentenceEn: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the "follow your passion" path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.
socioeconomic.translationZh: 大学、工作场所和职业顾问向所有人宣扬"追随激情"的道路，却不创造公平的竞争环境，这会加剧职业追求者之间的社会经济不平等。
socioeconomic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

socioeconomic.sentenceEn: Interestingly, when participants were separated by party affiliation, this effect was significant among Republicans but not Democrats, suggesting that the kind of messages implicit in these TV shows may play into people's existing socioeconomic beliefs.
socioeconomic.translationZh: 有趣的是，当按党派划分参与者时，这种效应在共和党人中显著，而在民主党人中则不显著，这表明这些电视节目中隐含的信息类型可能会影响人们现有的社会经济信念。
socioeconomic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

socioeconomic.sentenceEn: The study specifically focused on curiosity levels, which are associated with enhanced learning and higher academic achievement in reading and math at kindergarten, and behavioral-developmental benefits, especially for children from families with lower socioeconomic status.
socioeconomic.translationZh: 该研究特别关注了好奇心水平，这种好奇心与幼儿园阶段阅读和数学学习能力的提升、学业成绩的提高有关，并且还具有行为发展方面的益处，尤其对来自社会经济地位较低家庭的儿童而言。
socioeconomic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

socioeconomic.sentenceEn: This was particularly true for children with socioeconomic disadvantages.
socioeconomic.translationZh: 这对于处于社会经济劣势的儿童来说尤其如此。
socioeconomic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

socioeconomic.sentenceEn: Some socioeconomic differences in child rearing have shrunk in the past ten years.
socioeconomic.translationZh: 在过去十年中，育儿方面的一些社会经济差异已经缩小。

socioeconomic.sentenceEn: Socioeconomic inequality is likely to persist.
socioeconomic.translationZh: 社会经济不平等可能会持续存在。

strategic.sentenceEn: Solidarity is not just a product of strategic calculations of how much it will benefit the self.
strategic.translationZh: 团结不仅仅是基于个人利益能获得多少的战略计算产物。
strategic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

strategic.sentenceEn: As leaders, they are expected to motivate and inspire their team in pursuit of longer-term strategic goals and also, less ambitiously but more practically, to monitor their daily output, to set clear expectations and to give regular feedback.
strategic.translationZh: 作为领导者，人们期望他们能够激励和鼓舞团队追求长期战略目标，同时，虽然目标不那么宏大但更为实际的是，监督团队的日常产出、设定明确的期望并提供定期反馈。
strategic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

strategic.sentenceEn: But many other instances of expensive failed experiments suggest that creating a lasting global advantage actually requires a great deal of strategic and operational finesse(技巧).
strategic.translationZh: 但许多代价高昂的失败案例表明，创造持久的全球优势实际上需要高超的战略和运营技巧。
strategic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

strategic.sentenceEn: In addition, other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices: change in the strategic behavior of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries, the projected increase in Iranian exports, the scaling-down of global demand (especially from emerging markets), the long-term drop in petroleum consumption in the United States, and some displacement of oil by substitutes.
strategic.translationZh: 此外，其他因素也在给油价带来下行压力：石油输出国组织战略行为的改变、伊朗出口的预期增长、全球需求的缩减（尤其是来自新兴市场的需求）、美国石油消费的长期下降，以及部分石油被替代品取代。

strategic.sentenceEn: M: Strategic innovation is the process of managing innovation, of making sure it takes place at all levels of the company and that it's related to the company's overall strategy.
strategic.translationZh: 男：战略创新是管理创新的过程，确保创新在公司各个层面都能发生，并且与公司的整体战略相关联。
strategic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

strategic.sentenceEn: What are leaders expected to do in pursuing their strategic goals?
strategic.translationZh: 领导者在追求战略目标时应该做什么？

stressed.sentenceEn: When we wear ill-fitting clothes, or feel over- or under-dressed for an event, it's natural to feel self-conscious or even stressed .
stressed.translationZh: 当我们穿着不合身的衣服，或者感觉在某个场合穿着过于隆重或过于随意时，自然会感到不自在甚至有压力。
stressed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

stressed.sentenceEn: We are more likely to lie, when we are able to rationalise it, when we are stressed and fatigued or see others being dishonest.
stressed.translationZh: 当我们能够为谎言找到合理借口、感到压力和疲惫，或者看到他人不诚实时，我们就更容易撒谎。
stressed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

stressed.sentenceEn: If after work you lie around on your bed and get irritated by political commentary on your phone or get stressed thinking about decisions about how to renovate your home, your brain has not received a break from high mental arousal states.
stressed.translationZh: 如果下班后你只是躺在床上，却因手机上的政治评论而心烦意乱，或是为思考如何装修房子的决策而倍感压力，那么你的大脑其实并未从高度的精神兴奋状态中得到真正的休息。

stressed.sentenceEn: Chances are, you included things like happy, sad, excited, angry, afraid, grateful, proud, scared, confused, stressed , relaxed and amazed.
stressed.translationZh: 你的清单上可能会有开心、难过、兴奋、生气、害怕、感激、自豪、恐惧、困惑、紧张、放松和惊讶等情绪。
stressed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

stressed.sentenceEn: The 83% of American employees who are stressed about their jobs—up from 73% just a year before—say that poor compensation and an unreasonable workload are their number-one sources of stress.
stressed.translationZh: 83%的美国员工表示工作压力大（这一比例较一年前的73%有所上升），他们认为薪酬低下和不合理的工作量是压力的首要来源。

stressed.sentenceEn: They feel stressed out even without any challenges in life.
stressed.translationZh: 即使生活中没有任何挑战，他们也会感到压力重重。

stressful.sentenceEn: New research suggests cyberloafing can help workers cope with an exceptionally stressful work environment.
stressful.translationZh: 新研究表明，网络摸鱼可以帮助员工应对压力异常大的工作环境。
stressful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

stressful.sentenceEn: This suggests that cyberloafing acts as a sort of relief valve for workers, helping them recover from stressful experiences.
stressful.translationZh: 这表明，网络摸鱼对员工而言就像是一种泄压阀，帮助他们从充满压力的经历中恢复过来。
stressful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第9句

stressful.sentenceEn: Our hypothesis was that cyberloafing may serve as a mini-break, giving employees an opportunity to recover from stressful work situations.
stressful.translationZh: 我们的假设是，网络摸鱼可能起到短暂休息的作用，让员工有机会从紧张的工作环境中恢复过来。
stressful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

stressful.sentenceEn: Researchers discovered that placing rats in a stressful situation for just a few hours doubled the growth of new brain cells.
stressful.translationZh: 研究人员发现，将大鼠置于压力环境中仅几小时，就能使新脑细胞的生长增加一倍。
stressful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

stressful.sentenceEn: What did researchers discover about rats placed briefly in a stressful situation?
stressful.translationZh: 研究人员发现，将老鼠短暂置于压力环境中会有什么结果？

stressful.sentenceEn: It is more stressful than simultaneous interpreting.
stressful.translationZh: 它比同声传译更具压力。

substantial.sentenceEn: If I fancy something more substantial than a sandwich, but I don't have much time for lunch, the university canteen is always a good option.
substantial.translationZh: 如果我想吃点比三明治更管饱的东西，但午饭时间又比较紧，学校食堂总是很好的选择。
substantial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

substantial.sentenceEn: There are substantial , thought-out policy proposals on both sides of the argument.
substantial.translationZh: 争论双方都提出了大量经过深思熟虑的政策建议。

substantial.sentenceEn: As long as such schemes are voluntary, there will probably be a growing number of convenience-oriented uses so that a substantial number of workers would opt to have a chip inserted.
substantial.translationZh: 只要这类方案是自愿参与的，就可能会出现越来越多以便利为导向的应用，从而使相当一部分员工选择植入芯片。
substantial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

substantial.sentenceEn: Indeed, it's a bit of a mystery why governments, archaeologists, and treasure hunters can't work together—and why salvors aren't at least given a substantial finder's fee before the original owner takes possession of the vessel and its artifacts.
substantial.translationZh: 的确，令人费解的是，为何政府、考古学家和寻宝者不能携手合作——以及为何在原主收回沉船及其文物之前，打捞者至少不能获得一笔可观的发现者报酬。

substantial.sentenceEn: M: Obviously, I can't disclose the exact amount he paid, but it was substantial .
substantial.translationZh: 男：显然，我不能透露他支付的具体金额，但数额相当可观。
substantial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

substantial.sentenceEn: "You have to spend substantial capital in creating awareness around their likeness and making sure people are familiar with who they are," says Cloyd.
substantial.translationZh: 克洛伊德表示：“你必须投入大量资金来提高人们对这些数字人物形象的认知度，确保人们熟悉他们是谁。”

subtle.sentenceEn: The new findings are important because they elaborate our understanding of a subtle but common aspect of our daily experience.
subtle.translationZh: 这些新发现非常重要，因为它们深化了我们对日常生活中一种微妙但却普遍存在的现象的理解。
subtle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

subtle.sentenceEn: If high-street fast food is automation-ready, its impact on high-end restaurants is likely to be subtler and slower.
subtle.translationZh: 如果说街头快餐店已经准备好迎接自动化，那么自动化对高端餐厅的影响则可能更为微妙且缓慢。

subtle.sentenceEn: Apart from the AI creativity gap, great cooking involves a subtle understanding of ingredients and delicate cooking that would be enormously challenging for robots.
subtle.translationZh: 除了 AI 在创造力方面的差距外，精湛的烹饪还涉及对食材的细微理解和精细的烹饪技巧，而这对于机器人来说将是极大的挑战。

subtle.sentenceEn: After all, when you come right down to it, sarcasm can be used as a subtle form of bullying—and most bullies are angry, insecure, or cowardly.
subtle.translationZh: 毕竟，归根结底，讽刺可以被用作一种隐晦的霸凌手段——而大多数霸凌者内心都充满愤怒、缺乏安全感，或者胆小怯懦。
subtle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

subtle.sentenceEn: People are endlessly fascinated by themselves and their friends, and the subtle differences in how people think about the world are really meaningful to them.
subtle.translationZh: 人们总是对自己和朋友充满好奇，而人们思考世界方式上的细微差异对他们而言确实意义非凡。
subtle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

subtle.sentenceEn: Most people find it subtle and complicated to give up using the internet.
subtle.translationZh: 然而，彻底放弃使用互联网对大多数人来说是一个相当微妙和复杂的问题。

supervisor.sentenceEn: There are also instances where supervisors do not intervene either.
supervisor.translationZh: 也存在监管者不进行干预的情况。
supervisor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

supervisor.sentenceEn: Beyond competent workers and supervisors , it's important to educate everyone within the organization that they are obliged to intervene if they witness a possible unsafe act, whether you're a designated competent person, a supervisor or a frontline worker.
supervisor.translationZh: 除了合格的员工和主管外，重要的是要让组织内的每个人都明白：无论你是指定的合格人员、主管还是一线员工，只要目睹可能不安全的行为，都有义务进行干预。
supervisor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

supervisor.sentenceEn: Supervisors also play a critical role.
supervisor.translationZh: 管理者也扮演着关键角色。
supervisor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

supervisor.sentenceEn: Even if a competent person isn't required, supervisors need a broad set of skills to not only identify and alleviate workplace hazards but also build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening and open communication among them.
supervisor.translationZh: 即使不需要专业人员，主管也需要具备广泛的技能，不仅要识别和减轻工作场所的危害，还要在团队中营造安全氛围，支持团队成员之间的干预和开放沟通。
supervisor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

supervisor.sentenceEn: Supervisors ' helping behavior was found to be motivational in nature.
supervisor.translationZh: 研究发现，主管的助人行为本质上具有激励作用。
supervisor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

supervisor.sentenceEn: Supervisors conduct effective communication with frontline workers.
supervisor.translationZh: 主管与一线员工进行有效沟通。

surprised.sentenceEn: If you've experienced a similar situation, you probably won't be surprised by the results of the experiments.
surprised.translationZh: 如果你有过类似的经历，那么你可能对这些实验结果并不会感到意外。
surprised.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句
文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

surprised.sentenceEn: You will be surprised at how good it makes you feel and the potentially positive change in your health.
surprised.translationZh: 你会惊讶于它带给你的良好感觉，以及对你健康可能产生的积极变化。
surprised.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

surprised.sentenceEn: And you will not be surprised to hear that the majority of them are women.
surprised.translationZh: 听到其中大多数是女性，你不会感到惊讶。
surprised.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

surprised.sentenceEn: One recent study asked participants to write a note of thanks to someone and then estimate how surprised and happy the recipient would feel—an impact that they consistently underestimated.
surprised.translationZh: 最近的一项研究要求参与者给某人写一封感谢信，然后评估收信人会感到多么惊喜和开心——而他们始终低估了这种影响。

surprised.sentenceEn: No one in fashion is surprised that Burberry burnt £28 million of stock
surprised.translationZh: 博柏利烧毁价值2800万英镑的库存，时尚界对此并不意外

susceptible.sentenceEn: If quitting is "not your thing", you may be especially susceptible to this bias.
susceptible.translationZh: 如果你“从不轻言放弃”，那么你可能特别容易受到这种偏见的影响。

susceptible.sentenceEn: We are all susceptible to the sunk-cost delusion, an unconscious bias that leads us to persist in an endeavor we have already invested time, effort, or money into — even when abandoning it would be more beneficial.
susceptible.translationZh: 我们都容易受到沉没成本谬误的影响。这是一种无意识的偏见，促使我们坚持投入了时间、精力或金钱的事业——即便放弃它会更有利。

susceptible.sentenceEn: That's because higher levels of anxiety may make people more susceptible to negative feelings, putting them in a more negative state of mind.
susceptible.translationZh: 这是因为较高的焦虑水平可能使人们更容易受到负面情绪的影响，从而让他们处于一种更消极的心理状态。
susceptible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

susceptible.sentenceEn: We are also highly susceptible to a range of cognitive biases such as giving preference to the first things that come to mind when making decisions or giving weight to evidence.
susceptible.translationZh: 我们还极易受到一系列认知偏差的影响，例如在做决定时优先考虑首先想到的事情，或者过分看重某些证据。
susceptible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

susceptible.sentenceEn: Africa is especially susceptible to the effects of global warming partly because it has difficulty feeding its increasing population even without climate change.
susceptible.translationZh: 非洲特别容易受到全球变暖的影响，部分原因是即使没有气候变化，它也难以养活其不断增长的人口。

susceptible.sentenceEn: They are quite susceptible to suicide.

salvor.sentenceEn: Archaeologists regard themselves as protectors of history, and they see salvors as careless destroyers.
salvor.translationZh: 考古学家视自己为历史的守护者，而他们则将打捞人员看作是粗心大意的破坏者。

salvor.sentenceEn: In May 2016, a salvor named Bobby Pritchett, president of Global Marine Exploration (GME) in Tampa, Florida, announced that he had discovered scattered remains of a ship buried a kilometer off Cape Canaveral.
salvor.translationZh: 2016年5月，佛罗里达州坦帕市全球海洋探索公司（GME）总裁、打捞员鲍比·普里切特宣布，他在卡纳维拉尔角外一公里处发现了一艘沉船的散落残骸。

salvor.sentenceEn: But of late, when salvors have found vessels, their rights have been challenged in court.
salvor.translationZh: 但近来，当打捞人员发现船只时，他们的所有权却在法庭上受到了质疑。

salvor.sentenceEn: Where once salvors and archaeologists worked side by side, now they belong to opposing, and equally contemptuous, tribes.
salvor.translationZh: 曾经打捞人员与考古学家并肩合作，如今却成了相互对立、彼此鄙夷的阵营。

salvor.sentenceEn: But this is far from the first time a salvor has lost all rights to a discovery.
salvor.translationZh: 但这远非打捞者首次失去对所发现物品的全部权利。

salvor.sentenceEn: With technological advancement in recent years, salvors now can detect the invaluable man-made objects lying buried under the sea.
salvor.translationZh: 近年来，随着技术的进步，打捞人员现在能够探测到埋在海底的珍贵人工制品。

saying.sentenceEn: We've all repeatedly heard the saying that "quitters never win", but sometimes the best decision is to cut our losses.
saying.translationZh: 我们都反复听过“半途而废者永不会成功”这句名言，但有时最好的决定其实是及时止损。

saying.sentenceEn: The old military saying "You never rise to the occasion, you only sink to the level of training" also applies to behavior change.
saying.translationZh: 古老的军事谚语"你永远无法超越平时的训练水平，只能发挥训练时的水准"同样适用于行为改变。

saying.sentenceEn: As the saying goes: "Do as I do, not as I say".
saying.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

saying.sentenceEn: The saying "blind as a bat" simply isn't correct.
saying.translationZh: 俗话说“蝙蝠是瞎子”根本不正确。
saying.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

saying.sentenceEn: The studies also ran up against many methodological challenges, the biggest of which centered on the old statistical saying —correlation does not equal causation.
saying.translationZh: 这些研究还面临着许多方法论上的挑战，其中最大的挑战集中在那句古老的统计学名言——相关性不等于因果关系。
saying.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第9句

saying.sentenceEn: Why is the saying "copy from two, it's research" a lesson to learn?
saying.translationZh: 为什么说“借鉴两人，便是研究”是一条值得学习的经验？

self.sentenceEn: Only with a richer theory of the self and a larger test battery will we be able to determine all of the various levels of self-awareness, including where exactly fish fit in.
self.translationZh: 只有拥有更完善的自我理论和更全面的测试手段，我们才能确定自我意识的所有不同层级，并弄清楚鱼类究竟处于其中的什么位置。
self.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

self.sentenceEn: Solidarity is not just a product of strategic calculations of how much it will benefit the self .
self.translationZh: 团结不仅仅是基于个人利益能获得多少的战略计算产物。
self.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

self.sentenceEn: This singular, fixed sense of self was clouding her judgment and limiting her choices for action.
self.translationZh: 这种单一且固化的自我意识正蒙蔽她的判断力，并限制她做出行动选择。

self.sentenceEn: You may feel as if you are an independent individual, acting autonomously in the world; that you have an unchanging inner self that persists throughout your lifetime, acting as a central anchor-point with the world changing around you.
self.translationZh: 你可能会觉得自己是一个独立的个体，在世界上自主行动；你拥有一个终生不变的内在自我，在周围世界不断变化的同时，作为一个核心锚点存在。
self.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

self.sentenceEn: What does Professor Tom Oliver think of the idea that we exist as independent selves at the centre of a subjective universe?
self.translationZh: 汤姆·奥利弗教授如何看待我们作为独立自我存在于主观宇宙中心这一观点？

self.sentenceEn: He has found that our inner self and material self are interconnected.
self.translationZh: 他发现我们的内在自我与物质自我是相互关联的。

sensible.sentenceEn: However, according to numerous sensible statistics, these people are simply wrong.
sensible.translationZh: 然而，根据大量客观合理的统计数据，这些人的看法完全是错误的。
sensible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

sensible.sentenceEn: The authors, who focus on education in England, offer a number of sensible recommendations, some of which are an attempt to alleviate the uninspiring and fact-based approach to education that has crept into policy in recent years.
sensible.translationZh: 报告作者聚焦英格兰教育体系，提出了多项合理建议，其中部分旨在缓解近年来悄然渗入教育政策的那种枯燥乏味、以事实为本的教学方式。
sensible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

sensible.sentenceEn: No one can currently say where the new jobs are coming from or when, and any sensible company or country should prepare for all alternatives.
sensible.translationZh: 目前没人能确定新的就业机会将从何而来，也不知道何时会出现，因此任何明智的企业或国家都应当为各种可能性做好准备。
sensible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

sensible.sentenceEn: Given that there's now over $1.3 trillion in student loans on the books, it's pretty clear that many students are far from sensible .
sensible.translationZh: 鉴于目前学生贷款账面金额已超过1.3万亿美元，显然许多学生的做法很不明智。
sensible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

sensible.sentenceEn: So if you are a student who always reviews over black coffee, perhaps it would be sensible to prime yourself with a cup before the exam.
sensible.translationZh: 因此，如果你是一个总在喝黑咖啡时复习的学生，那么在考试前喝一杯咖啡来让自己进入状态或许是明智之举。
sensible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

sensible.sentenceEn: It is not sensible to expect digital tech to take humans' interest to heart.
sensible.translationZh: 指望数字技术能把人类的利益放在心上是不切实际的。

shared.sentenceEn: Instead, they should compel us to address our shared issues head-on.
shared.translationZh: 相反，它们应当促使我们正视并解决共同面临的问题。
shared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

shared.sentenceEn: Does the group you belong to have a strong collective consciousness or shared beliefs?
shared.translationZh: 你所属的群体是否具有强烈的集体意识或共同信念？
shared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

shared.sentenceEn: It was a shared effort where everybody pitched in for the communal good.
shared.translationZh: 这是一项集体努力，每个人都为共同利益贡献了力量。
shared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

shared.sentenceEn: The idea was that if all the properties looked a certain way with shared design features, then a village as a whole would look more beautiful.
shared.translationZh: 其理念是，如果所有建筑都采用某种特定风格并共享设计元素，那么整个村庄将会更加美观。
shared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

shared.sentenceEn: So, people do not have the same level of shared taste.
shared.translationZh: 所以，人们的共同品味水平并不相同。
shared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

shared.sentenceEn: Establish socially shared cognition via scientific methods.
shared.translationZh: 通过科学方法建立社会共享认知

soda.sentenceEn: Later in life, when that child wants to experience a joyous moment, they're going to think of soda .
soda.translationZh: 在后来的生活中，当这个孩子想要体验快乐时刻时，他们就会想到苏打水。
soda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

soda.sentenceEn: Soda companies discovered that if they put a soda in the hands of a child when they're at a ball game with their parents, that soda will forever be associated with that joyous moment.
soda.translationZh: 汽水公司发现，如果在孩子和父母一起看球赛时把一瓶汽水交到孩子手中，那么这种汽水就会永远与那个欢乐的时刻联系在一起。
soda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

soda.sentenceEn: Though cocoa seed is not an ingredient of the soda , they designed their bottle based on the seed's shape and large middle.
soda.translationZh: 尽管可可籽并非这种汽水的原料，但他们还是根据可可籽的形状和饱满的中部来设计瓶子。
soda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

soda.sentenceEn: Most Americans don't drink soda out of the glass bottles seen in Coke's ads anymore.
soda.translationZh: 如今，大多数美国人已不再用可口可乐广告中出现的那种玻璃瓶来喝苏打汽水了。
soda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

soda.sentenceEn: The first year it was available, Coca-Cola averaged nine servings a day across all the Atlanta soda fountains where it was sold.
soda.translationZh: 可口可乐上市的第一年，在亚特兰大所有销售它的汽水 fountain 中，平均每天销量为九份。
soda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

soda.sentenceEn: Rights were sold to bottle the soda .
soda.translationZh: 公司出售了这种汽水的瓶装权

somewhat.sentenceEn: She's scientifically-minded, practical, somewhat cynical, and always skeptical.
somewhat.translationZh: 她具有科学思维，注重实际，略带愤世嫉俗，且总是持怀疑态度。
somewhat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

somewhat.sentenceEn: Although the children's reactions were somewhat expected, the new study did contain an unexpected finding: Many of the surveyed children revealed that their parents also expressed fear or disgust of the same animals.
somewhat.translationZh: 尽管孩子们的反应在某种程度上在意料之中，但这项新研究确实包含了一个意外发现：许多接受调查的孩子表示，他们的父母对同样的动物也表现出恐惧或厌恶。

somewhat.sentenceEn: Despite the huge investment into research, ageing remains somewhat obscure, although there are certain things researchers do understand.
somewhat.translationZh: 尽管在研究上投入巨大，但衰老过程仍然有些神秘莫测，不过研究人员确实已经了解了一些相关情况。
somewhat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

somewhat.sentenceEn: He or she will instead point out, constructively and tactfully, exactly how their inflated sense of deservingness is somewhat distorted.
somewhat.translationZh: 相反，他们会有建设性且委婉地指出，员工这种过度膨胀的应得感是如何有些扭曲的。
somewhat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

somewhat.sentenceEn: According to the man, what might account for Peter appearing somewhat more self-assured than Rachel?
somewhat.translationZh: 根据这位男士的说法，什么可能是彼得显得比瑞秋更自信的原因？

stimulus.sentenceEn: As such, an intervention like a simulation can provide the stimulus for change.
stimulus.translationZh: 因此，像模拟这样的干预措施可以为变革提供刺激。
stimulus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

stimulus.sentenceEn: Well-designed simulations can enable individuals and groups to develop a deep level of understanding about how their decisions and intuitive responses to business stimuli affect their fellow participants and the organization as a whole.
stimulus.translationZh: 精心设计的模拟能够让个人和团队深入理解他们的决策以及对业务刺激的直觉反应如何影响其他参与者和整个组织。
stimulus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

stimulus.sentenceEn: "Learning from less variable input is often fast, but may fail to generalise to new stimuli ."
stimulus.translationZh: 从变化较小的输入中学习通常速度很快，但可能无法推广到新的刺激。
stimulus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

stimulus.sentenceEn: Some researchers argue that doodling(涂画) activates the brain's so-called default circuit—essentially, the areas of the brain responsible for maintaining a baseline level of activity in the absence of other stimuli .
stimulus.translationZh: 一些研究人员认为，涂画能激活大脑中所谓的默认回路——本质上，这是大脑中负责在没有其他刺激时维持基本活动水平的区域。
stimulus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

stimulus.sentenceEn: What does Martin Neil Baily think of a second stimulus to the economy?
stimulus.translationZh: 马丁·尼尔·贝利如何看待对经济的第二次刺激计划？

stimulus.sentenceEn: They are interventions different from simulations in creating stimuli for change.
stimulus.translationZh: 它们是不同于模拟的干预措施，旨在创造变革的刺激因素。

structural.sentenceEn: Instead, there are structural reasons that women are disadvantaged in science.
structural.translationZh: 相反，女性在科学界处于不利地位是存在结构性原因的。
structural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

structural.sentenceEn: After two years, Habibi and her colleagues reported seeing structural changes in the brains of the musically trained children, both locally and in the pathways connecting different parts of the brain.
structural.translationZh: 两年后，哈比比及其同事报告称，在接受音乐训练的儿童大脑中观察到了结构性变化，这种变化既存在于局部区域，也存在于连接大脑不同部位的神经通路上。

structural.sentenceEn: As the structural nature of public health problems becomes harder to ignore, the complaint about over protective government loses potency.
structural.translationZh: 随着公共卫生问题的结构性本质愈发难以忽视，关于政府过度保护的抱怨也失去了说服力。
structural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

structural.sentenceEn: In other words, structural unemployment is a fake problem, which mainly serves as an excuse for not pursuing real solutions.
structural.translationZh: 换句话说，结构性失业是个伪命题，它主要是为不寻求真正解决方案找借口。
structural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

structural.sentenceEn: What has caused claims of huge structural problems to multiply?
structural.translationZh: 是什么导致有关巨大结构性问题的说法日益增多？
实施全面的结构性改革

suddenly.sentenceEn: Shoving the big bear aside with one hand, the man continued feeding the cubs when suddenly he was struck a fierce blow in the face.
suddenly.translationZh: 该男子用一只手将母熊推到一旁，继续喂小熊，突然脸上遭到猛击。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

suddenly.sentenceEn: I had been a big, tough 8th grader and suddenly I was a lonely 9th grader bullied by the big, tough 12th grade seniors who ran the high school.
suddenly.translationZh: 我曾是个高大强壮的八年级学生，可突然间，我成了一个孤独的九年级新生，被那些在高中里称王称霸的高大强壮的十二年级学长欺负。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

suddenly.sentenceEn: In January 1901, at 1,020 feet-almost precisely the depth predicted by Higgins' wild guess—the well roared and suddenly ejected mud and six tons of drilling pipe out of the ground, terrifying those present.
suddenly.translationZh: 1901年1月，在1020英尺深处——几乎与希金斯胡乱猜测的深度完全一致——油井突然咆哮起来，猛地将泥浆和六吨重的钻杆喷出地面，令在场的人惊恐不已。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

suddenly.sentenceEn: Praise won for mastering a skill suddenly puts one in the position of having everything to lose.
suddenly.translationZh: 因掌握某项技能而获得的赞誉，会突然让人陷入一种仿佛拥有一切可失去的境地。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

suddenly.sentenceEn: W: That money left our account, and now that you should be paying out, you're suddenly saying that you didn't receive it on time.
suddenly.translationZh: W：那笔钱早就从我们账户划走了，现在轮到你们赔付了，你们却突然说没按时收到保费。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

suddenly.sentenceEn: The notion that they're utterly powerless suddenly seems unrealistic—not to mention rather annoying—so they're prompted instead to generate ideas about how they might change things.
suddenly.translationZh: 他们完全无能为力的想法突然显得不切实际——更不用说是相当令人恼火的——因此反而会促使他们思考如何改变现状。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

supporter.sentenceEn: Supporters of libraries as community builders claim that unless you are out there changing neighborhoods, you are not completing the work you are to do.
supporter.translationZh: 支持图书馆作为社区建设者的人认为，除非你切实参与到社区改造中，否则你就没有完成应尽的工作。

supporter.sentenceEn: Leon Clarke, who helped author reports for the UN's Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, isn't an uncritical supporter of nuclear energy, but says it's a valuable option to have if we're serious about reaching carbon neutrality.
supporter.translationZh: 莱昂·克拉克曾参与撰写联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会的报告，他并非核能的无条件支持者，但他表示，如果我们真的想实现碳中和，核能是一个有价值的选择。
supporter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

supporter.sentenceEn: I'm a lifelong Real Madrid supporter and go to their games every weekend I can.
supporter.translationZh: 我是皇家马德里的终身球迷，只要有时间，每个周末都会去看他们的比赛。
supporter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

supporter.sentenceEn: A mannerly aura(氛围) hangs over most classical proceedings, and many of the genre's biggest supporters would have it no other way.
supporter.translationZh: 大多数古典音乐演出都笼罩着一种彬彬有礼的氛围，而这一流派的众多忠实拥趸也乐见其成。

supporter.sentenceEn: What is the supporters' argument for workplace surveillance?
supporter.translationZh: 工作场所监控的支持者有什么论点？

supporter.sentenceEn: Both supporters and opponents should make compromises.
supporter.translationZh: 支持者和反对者双方都应做出妥协。

surge.sentenceEn: In recent years, however, many countries have witnessed a surge in the number of small businesses and companies offering more environment-friendly cleaning products, and they're doing good business too.
surge.translationZh: 然而，近年来，许多国家出现了大量提供更环保清洁产品的小型企业和公司，它们的生意也很不错。
surge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

surge.sentenceEn: One study shows that rats that experienced brief stress had a surge of immune cell response, which makes the immune system better prepared to fight illness.
surge.translationZh: 一项研究表明，经历短暂压力的大鼠免疫细胞反应激增，这使免疫系统能更好地准备对抗疾病。
surge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

surge.sentenceEn: Among large traditional retailers, Walmart recently reported the best results, leading its stock price to surge , while Macy's, Target, and Nordstrom's dropped.
surge.translationZh: 在大型传统零售商中，沃尔玛最近公布的业绩最佳，带动其股价飙升，而梅西百货、塔吉特和诺德斯特龙的股价则出现下跌。

surge.sentenceEn: Sure enough, the Census Bureau just released data showing that online retail sales surged 15.2 percent between the first quarter of 2015 and the first quarter of 2016.
surge.translationZh: 果然，美国人口普查局刚刚发布的数据显示，2015年第一季度至2016年第一季度期间，在线零售额激增了15.2%。

surge.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about the temperature surge in the Arctic?
surge.translationZh: 这篇文章关于北极的气温飙升说了些什么？

surge.sentenceEn: It has witnessed a spectacular surge in demand.
surge.translationZh: 其需求量出现了惊人的增长。

suspect.sentenceEn: We worry because we suspect —not wrongly—that the world is full of a frightening sort of person ready to judge us ruthlessly and swiftly: a person we can call a snob.
suspect.translationZh: 我们感到忧虑，因为我们不无道理地怀疑：世界上充斥着一种可怕的人，他们随时准备对我们进行无情而迅速的评判——我们可以称这种人为势利小人。
suspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

suspect.sentenceEn: For example, if people feel they are not worthy of kindness or suspect that some ulterior(别有用心的) motive lies behind it, the benefits of gratitude will not be realized.
suspect.translationZh: 例如，如果人们觉得自己不配得到善意，或者怀疑善意背后隐藏着别有用心的动机，感恩所带来的益处就无法实现。

suspect.sentenceEn: The scientists suspect that micro-organisms may be living in Lake Vostok, closed off from the outside world for more than 2 million years.
suspect.translationZh: 科学家们怀疑，沃斯托克湖中可能存在微生物，这个湖泊与外界隔绝已有200多万年。
suspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

suspect.sentenceEn: I suspect that some experts in the field will be keen to address alternative explanations, such as unassessed variables playing a role in the wellbeing decline.
suspect.translationZh: 我猜想该领域的一些专家会热衷于探讨其他解释，比如未被评估的变量在幸福感下降中所起的作用。

suspect.sentenceEn: But Steinberg suspected this tendency could also have its advantages.
suspect.translationZh: 但斯坦伯格怀疑这种倾向也可能有其优势。

suspect.sentenceEn: The story of the oak tree is suspected to have been invented as a thought exercise.
suspect.translationZh: 橡树的故事被怀疑是作为一种思维训练而虚构出来的。

satisfied.sentenceEn: It can leave people less satisfied with their face-to-face interactions.
satisfied.translationZh: 这会降低人们对面对面交流的满意度。
satisfied.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句
