satisfied.sentenceEn: Owls are not satisfied until a solution is found that achieves their own goals and the other person's goals, and they are not satisfied until the tensions and negative feelings have been fully resolved.
satisfied.translationZh: 猫头鹰型的人只有在找到既能实现自身目标又能满足对方目标的解决方案后，并且只有在紧张情绪和负面感受得到完全化解后，才会感到满意。
satisfied.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

satisfied.sentenceEn: "It is true that any interaction with nature is better than none, but I don't want people to be satisfied with any small bit of grass and trees," Lev says.
satisfied.translationZh: 莱夫说：“的确，与自然有任何互动总比完全没有强，但我不希望人们满足于仅仅一小片草地和树木。”

satisfied.sentenceEn: According to Howard Pollio, professor of psychology at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, an office with humour breaks is an office with satisfied and productive employees.
satisfied.translationZh: 田纳西大学诺克斯维尔分校心理学教授霍华德·波利奥认为，拥有幽默休息时间的办公室，其员工会更满意且工作效率更高。
satisfied.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

satisfied.sentenceEn: Joseph's top priority became getting his hands on enough grass-fed milk to keep customers satisfied , since his own 64-cow herd wasn't going to suffice.
satisfied.translationZh: 约瑟夫的首要任务变成了获取足够的草饲牛奶以满足顾客需求，因为他自己的64头奶牛远远不够。

satisfied.sentenceEn: Many Americans are not satisfied with their income.
satisfied.translationZh: 许多美国人对自己的收入不满意。

scary.sentenceEn: This means simply that it is possible to observe ourselves having a craving, or a happy thought, or even a scary emotion, without reacting in the moment in a way that amplifies the feeling or sends the mind spiraling off into thinking about old memories or anticipating events.
scary.translationZh: 简单来说，这意味着我们可以观察自己产生某种渴望、愉悦的念头，甚至是恐惧的情绪，而不会在当下立即做出反应，从而避免加剧这种感受，或让思绪陷入对往事的回忆以及对未来的忧虑中。
scary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

scary.sentenceEn: I am fascinated with the paradox of horror—the strange fact that many people seek out scary entertainment.
scary.translationZh: 我对恐怖的悖论很着迷——许多人热衷于恐怖娱乐这一奇怪现象。
scary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

scary.sentenceEn: And, of course, maintaining support for preserving the wild spaces where these " scary " creatures live is the most important thing of all.
scary.translationZh: 当然，最重要的是持续支持保护这些“可怕”生物赖以生存的野生空间。

scary.sentenceEn: This is partly because of the risk that viewers find virtual humans scary .
scary.translationZh: 部分原因是观众可能会觉得虚拟人物令人毛骨悚然。

scary.sentenceEn: Why do many people seek out scary entertainment, according to the author's research?
scary.translationZh: 根据作者的研究，为什么许多人会寻求恐怖类娱乐？

scary.sentenceEn: It concentrates our mind on our personal feelings, happy or scary .
scary.translationZh: 它使我们全神贯注于个人的情感，无论是快乐还是恐惧。

secondary.sentenceEn: M: Actually, we support teams for secondary school students, too, and also have some public funding.
secondary.translationZh: 男：实际上，我们也支持中学生队伍，并且还获得了一些公共资金。
secondary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

secondary.sentenceEn: Science instruction can be found at all levels of public education with most secondary schools offering classes on biology, physics, and chemistry.
secondary.translationZh: 各级公共教育中都包含科学教学内容，大多数中学都开设了生物、物理和化学课程。
secondary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

secondary.sentenceEn: Characters that did represent a minority culture usually had secondary roles in the books.
secondary.translationZh: 那些确实代表少数族裔文化的角色在书中通常只担任次要角色。
secondary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

secondary.sentenceEn: So the voice actors are pushing for the idea of secondary compensation—a performance bonus every time a game sells 2 million copies or downloads, or reaches 2 million subscribers, with a cap at 8 million.
secondary.translationZh: 因此，配音演员们正在争取追加酬金制度——即每当一款游戏的销量或下载量达到200万份，或订阅用户数达到200万时，他们就能获得一笔表演奖金，而奖金上限为800万份/用户。
secondary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

secondary.sentenceEn: Overall, the strike is an effort to provide more secondary compensation along with other concerns, such as transparency upon hiring talent and on-set(制作中) safety precautions.
secondary.translationZh: 总体而言，此次罢工旨在争取更多的追加酬金，同时解决其他一些问题，例如在招聘演职人员时的透明度以及制作中的安全预防措施。
secondary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

secondary.sentenceEn: "It's a very small number of games that would trigger this secondary compensation issue," said voice actor Crispin Freeman, who's a member of the union's negotiating committee.
secondary.translationZh: 工会谈判委员会成员、配音演员克里斯平·弗里曼表示：“能够触发这种追加酬金机制的游戏数量其实非常少。”
secondary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

seeker.sentenceEn: He will line up Monday in Antarctica(南极) for the first leg of the World Marathon Challenge—joining 32 other adventure seekers on an unusual journey where participants travel through different time zones and climates to run seven marathons on seven continents in seven days.
seeker.translationZh: 周一，他将在南极站到起跑线前，参加世界马拉松挑战赛的第一站比赛——与其他32名探险爱好者一同踏上这段非凡旅程。参赛者将穿越不同时区和气候带，在七天内于七大洲完成七场马拉松。

seeker.sentenceEn: It's important for job seekers to do their homework on two crucial aspects.
seeker.translationZh: 求职者有必要在两个关键方面做好准备工作。
seeker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

seeker.sentenceEn: To come up with multiple career accomplishments or examples for different interview questions, job seekers should talk with others, especially people who know them, partners, friends or co-workers who will bring up different stories than the ones they remember.
seeker.translationZh: 为了准备多个职业成就案例或应对不同面试问题的例子，求职者应该与他人交流，尤其是那些了解他们的人——伴侣、朋友或同事，这些人往往能提出一些他们自己可能已经遗忘的故事。
seeker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

seeker.sentenceEn: "Tell me about yourself" may seem like an easy job interview question, but the open-ended nature of this question often leaves job seekers at a loss where to start.
seeker.translationZh: "请介绍一下你自己"看似是个简单的面试问题，但这种开放式问题往往让求职者不知从何说起。
seeker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

seeker.sentenceEn: What other important preparations should job seekers make before an interview?
seeker.translationZh: 求职者在面试前还应做哪些重要准备？

seeker.sentenceEn: It provided job opportunities for many gold seekers .
seeker.translationZh: 它为许多淘金者提供了就业机会。

selective.sentenceEn: Selective colleges and universities in the U.S. are under fire for being too elite and too expensive, and for not training graduates for the world of work.
selective.translationZh: 美国的精英高等院校因过于精英化、学费过高以及未能培养毕业生适应职场而备受抨击。
selective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

selective.sentenceEn: Access to an education at selective colleges and universities is now more available than ever to low- and middle-income families.
selective.translationZh: 如今，中低收入家庭比以往任何时候都更容易获得精英院校的教育机会。
selective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

selective.sentenceEn: What the research revealed was the rather less surprising result: the educational benefits of selective schools largely disappear once pupils' inborn ability and socio-economic background were taken into account.
selective.translationZh: 该研究揭示的结果其实并不那么令人惊讶：一旦将学生的先天能力和社会经济背景纳入考虑，精英学校的教育优势在很大程度上就消失了。
selective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

selective.sentenceEn: This is down to "hereditarian"(遗传论的) science and a recent paper claimed "differences in exam performance between pupils attending selective and non-selective schools mirror the genetic differences between them".
selective.translationZh: 这要归因于“遗传论”科学，最近有一篇论文声称“就读精英学校和非精英学校的学生在考试成绩上的差异，反映了他们之间的基因差异”。
selective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

selective.sentenceEn: What fact does the author emphasize concerning selective colleges and universities?
selective.translationZh: 关于精英学院和大学，作者强调了什么事实？

selective.sentenceEn: He told the man to be selective when using e-resources.
selective.translationZh: 他告诉那个人使用电子资源时要有所选择。

setback.sentenceEn: When we focus on the things we regret, such as failed relationships, family disputes, and setbacks in career and finance, we tend to become more regretful.
setback.translationZh: 当我们把注意力集中在那些令我们遗憾的事情上，比如失败的恋情、家庭纠纷以及职场和财务上的挫折时，我们往往会变得更加懊悔。

setback.sentenceEn: In well-adjusted perfectionism, someone who doesn't get the gold is able to forget the setback and move on.
setback.translationZh: 在适度的完美主义中，未能获得金牌的人能够忘记挫折，继续前进。

setback.sentenceEn: They can also regroup quickly when a setback occurs, adapting to the new situation confidently and without overreacting.
setback.translationZh: 当遇到挫折时，他们也能迅速重整旗鼓，自信地适应新情况，而不会反应过度。
setback.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

setback.sentenceEn: After encountering several setbacks , Captain Lucas decided to use a drill, and his innovations created the modern oil drilling industry.
setback.translationZh: 在遭遇数次挫折后，卢卡斯上尉决定使用钻机，他的创新之举催生了现代石油钻探业。
setback.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

setback.sentenceEn: Many people believe changing the world is possible, though it may take time and involve setbacks .
setback.translationZh: 许多人相信改变世界是可能的，尽管这可能需要时间并会遇到挫折。
提前充分预估可能遇到的挫折。

sex.sentenceEn: How do the sexes differ in their friendship relations?
sex.translationZh: 不同性别在友谊关系上有何差异？
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

sex.sentenceEn: There's little argument that some personality traits appear more dominant in one sex than in the other.
sex.translationZh: 人们几乎一致认为，某些性格特征在某一性别中比在另一性别中更为突出。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

sex.sentenceEn: Actually, dating dilutes the intensity of same sex friendships for men also.
sex.translationZh: 事实上，约会也会冲淡男性间同性友谊的亲密程度。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

sex.sentenceEn: These early attitudes, reinforced by social conditioning, continue to play an active part in the friendships of both sexes during adolescence.
sex.translationZh: 这些早期形成的态度，在社会环境的不断强化下，在青春期男女的友谊关系中继续发挥着重要作用。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

sex.sentenceEn: Most preteen children have a best friend who is usually someone of the same sex and similar age.
sex.translationZh: 大多数青春期前的孩子都有一个最好的朋友，通常是同性且年龄相仿的人。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sex.sentenceEn: They make friends with peers of the same sex .
sex.translationZh: 他们与同性别的同龄人交朋友。

sharp.sentenceEn: Now, it's become something of a ritual to debate the value of a college degree, but as Current Population Survey data show, there has been a sharp decline in employment among men without college degrees compared with those who have them.
sharp.translationZh: 如今，争论大学学位的价值已成为一种常态，但美国当前人口调查（Current Population Survey）数据显示，与拥有大学学位的男性相比，没有大学学位的男性就业率出现了急剧下降。
sharp.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

sharp.sentenceEn: This is most apt to be the case in late adolescence, when dating and relationships with boys take sharp precedence over sisterhood.
sharp.translationZh: 这种情况在青春期后期尤为常见，此时与男孩约会和恋爱的重要性明显优先于姐妹情谊。
sharp.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

sharp.sentenceEn: The news was met with excitement by those keen to see Dean digitally brought back to life for only his fourth film, but it also drew sharp criticism.
sharp.translationZh: 这一消息让那些渴望看到迪恩通过数字技术复活、出演他仅有的第四部电影的人们兴奋不已，但也招致了尖锐批评。

sharp.sentenceEn: It stands in sharp contrast to Sanchez's other gadget, a gas-powered flame weedkiller invented in 1997.
sharp.translationZh: 这与桑切斯的另一个工具形成鲜明对比——一个1997年发明的燃气动力火焰除草器。
sharp.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

sharp.sentenceEn: The thin, extremely sharp needles didn't hurt at all going in.
sharp.translationZh: 那些纤细而异常锋利的针头刺入皮肤时，我完全没有感到疼痛。
sharp.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

sharp.sentenceEn: There is a sharp increase in India's balance of payment deficit.
sharp.translationZh: 印度的国际收支逆差急剧增加。

sleeping.sentenceEn: When psychologist Jessica Pryor lived near an internationally renowned university, she once saw a student walking into a library holding a sleeping bag and a coffee maker.
sleeping.translationZh: 心理学家杰西卡·普赖尔曾住在一所国际知名大学附近，有一次她看到一名学生抱着睡袋和咖啡机走进图书馆。

sleeping.sentenceEn: I'm going to prescribe some special sleeping pills for you.
sleeping.translationZh: 我会给你开一些特殊的安眠药。
sleeping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

sleeping.sentenceEn: Alcohol may increase the effect of a drug— sleeping pills combine with alcohol to produce a sleepy feeling.
sleeping.translationZh: 酒精可能会增强药物的效果——安眠药与酒精混合会产生嗜睡感。
sleeping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

sleeping.sentenceEn: Less than an hour away by snowmobile, Chinese labourers have updated the Great Wall Station, a vital part of China's plan to operate five bases on Antarctica, complete with an indoor badminton court and sleeping quarters for 150 people.
sleeping.translationZh: 乘坐雪地摩托不到一小时的路程，中国工人对长城站进行了翻新改造。该站是中国计划在南极洲运营五个科考站的重要组成部分，内部设有羽毛球场馆和可容纳150人的宿舍。

sleeping.sentenceEn: What is the long-held view about mothers' sleeping with newborn babies?
sleeping.translationZh: 关于母亲与新生婴儿同睡的长期观点是什么？

sleeping.sentenceEn: Buy some sleeping pills for him from the drugstore.
sleeping.translationZh: 从药店给他买些安眠药。

specialist.sentenceEn: So if humans ever succeed in reaching the stars, they may accomplish this feat, in part, by standing on the shoulders of the tiny eight-legged endurance specialists in your backyard.
specialist.translationZh: 因此，如果人类最终成功抵达星际，这一壮举的实现，在某种程度上，可能要归功于那些生活在你后院、拥有超凡耐力的小小八脚专家。
specialist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

specialist.sentenceEn: M: I'm glad to hear you find my work accessible, because I was worried when I wrote it that discussing the science might make the book more suited for a specialist audience.
specialist.translationZh: 男：很高兴听到您觉得我的作品通俗易懂，因为我写作时曾担心，过多讨论科学内容可能会使这本书更适合专业读者。
specialist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

specialist.sentenceEn: Statistics specialists , when they speak of national averages, often make the same mistake.
specialist.translationZh: 统计专家在谈论全国平均值时，也常常犯同样的错误。
specialist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

specialist.sentenceEn: So far, specialists have worked to add preservative materials to the churches' exteriors.
specialist.translationZh: 到目前为止，专家们已着手在教堂外部添加防腐材料。
specialist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

specialist.sentenceEn: According to an International Labor Organization's specialist , how will employers feel if there are more people looking for jobs?
specialist.translationZh: 根据国际劳工组织专家的说法，如果有更多人在找工作，雇主会作何感想？

specialist.sentenceEn: Turn to a specialist for professional help.
specialist.translationZh: 向专业人士寻求专业帮助。

spouse.sentenceEn: If we take the time to reflect we might recognise that as well as our work we can also identify as a friend, a spouse , a son or daughter, a parent, a member of a sports team or religious community.
spouse.translationZh: 如果我们花时间反思，可能会意识到，除了工作之外，我们还可以将自己定位为朋友、配偶、子女、父母、运动队成员或宗教团体成员。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

spouse.sentenceEn: Well, the researchers assert that it's important to address each person's underlying cause of loneliness, whether it's the death of a spouse , medical problems, or social expectations that haven't been fulfilled.
spouse.translationZh: 研究人员认为，重要的是要解决每个人孤独感背后的根本原因，无论是配偶离世、健康问题，还是未能实现的社会期望。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

spouse.sentenceEn: A person living with an other-oriented perfectionist might feel criticized by the perfectionist spouse for not doing household chores exactly the "right" way.
spouse.translationZh: 与具有他人导向型完美主义倾向的人共同生活的人，可能会因为家务没有完全按照“正确”方式完成而受到这位完美主义伴侣的批评。

spouse.sentenceEn: The team found that a person whose spouse had a higher level of education tended to report better health.
spouse.translationZh: 研究团队发现，配偶受教育程度较高的人往往自述健康状况更好。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

spouse.sentenceEn: For women, health was more closely correlated to their spouse's education than for men.
spouse.translationZh: 对于女性而言，健康状况与其配偶的受教育程度的相关性要高于男性。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第16句

spouse.sentenceEn: They had more education than their spouses .
spouse.translationZh: 他们比自己的配偶受教育程度更高。

stable.sentenceEn: While the passion principle is broadly popular, not everyone has the necessary resources to turn their passion into a stable , good-paying job.
stable.translationZh: 虽然“追随热情”的理念广受欢迎，但并非每个人都拥有必要的资源，将自己的热情转化为一份稳定且收入不错的工作。
stable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

stable.sentenceEn: The chaos and never-ending turmoil that accompanies everyday life is an aggressive obstacle in the pursuit of stable friendships.
stable.translationZh: 日常生活中伴随的混乱与无休止的纷扰，是追求稳定友谊道路上的巨大障碍。
stable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

stable.sentenceEn: A city with an average annual temperature closer to 22 tends to have a population who are more agreeable, conscientious, emotionally stable , and outgoing.
stable.translationZh: 年均气温接近22摄氏度的城市，其居民往往更随和、更有责任心、情绪更稳定且更外向。
stable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

stable.sentenceEn: She had no stable income, $12,000 in credit-card debt and no plan, but to her astonishment, her father, an accountant, told her that her financial plight wasn't as bad as she thought.
stable.translationZh: 她没有稳定的收入，背负着12,000美元的信用卡债务，也没有任何计划。但令她惊讶的是，身为会计师的父亲告诉她，她的财务困境并不像她想象的那么糟糕。
stable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

stable.sentenceEn: What is important to turning one's passion into a stable , good-paying job?
stable.translationZh: 如何将个人热情转化为一份稳定且收入不错的工作？这其中什么是关键？

stable.sentenceEn: Most families in the UK do not have stable broadband connections.
stable.translationZh: 英国大多数家庭没有稳定的宽带连接。

steam.sentenceEn: Just as in the myth, technology—first fire and stone tools, and later farming, the steam engine and industry, fossil fuels, chemicals and nuclear power—has allowed us to alter and control the natural world.
steam.translationZh: 正如神话中所述，技术——从最初的火与石器，到后来的农业、蒸汽机与工业、化石燃料、化学制品以及核能——使我们能够改变并控制自然界。

steam.sentenceEn: This would generate steam that could be used to fill tanks on a small steam train without the use of fire.
steam.translationZh: 这将产生蒸汽，可用于为小型蒸汽火车的储罐充能，且无需使用燃料点火。
steam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

steam.sentenceEn: Can you run a 140,000 kilogram train on just the steam generated by solar power?
steam.translationZh: 仅靠太阳能产生的蒸汽，能驱动一列重达14万公斤的火车吗？
steam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

steam.sentenceEn: As part of the upgrading of its rail yard, Castleman, who is an inventor and self-proclaimed steam visionary, is campaigning for a new steam train that runs without any fire and could run on an existing 10-kilometre line, drawing tourists and perhaps offering city commuters a green alternative to their cars.
steam.translationZh: 作为其铁路货场升级改造的一部分，身为发明家和自封的蒸汽梦想家的卡斯尔曼正在倡议建造一种无需燃烧燃料的新型蒸汽火车。这种火车可以在现有的10公里线路上运行，既能吸引游客，也可能为城市通勤者提供一种绿色的汽车替代方案。
steam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

steam.sentenceEn: According to Harry Valentine, a Canadian engineer who is researching modern steam technology, a special tank measuring 2 by 10 metres could store over 750 kilowatt-hours of energy as high-pressure steam , enough to pull a two-car train for an hour or so.
steam.translationZh: 据研究现代蒸汽技术的加拿大工程师哈里·瓦伦丁介绍，一个尺寸为2米×10米的特制储罐可以将超过750千瓦时的能量以高压蒸汽形式储存，足以牵引一列两节车厢的火车运行大约一小时。
steam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

steam.sentenceEn: The liquid is maintained above its melting point until steam is required, at which point the liquid is allowed to turn back into a solid, releasing its stored energy.
steam.translationZh: 这种液体被保持在熔点以上的温度，直到需要蒸汽时，才让液体重新凝固为固体，释放其储存的能量。
steam.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

storage.sentenceEn: Everything from production to storage and processing must improve.
storage.translationZh: 从生产到储存再到加工的各个环节都必须得到改善。
storage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

storage.sentenceEn: On the contrary, the personal storage business is now a growing industry.
storage.translationZh: 然而恰恰相反，个人存储业务如今已成为一个蓬勃发展的行业。
storage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

storage.sentenceEn: Another team at Nagoya University in Japan has tested calcium compound as an energy storage material.
storage.translationZh: 日本名古屋大学的另一个研究团队则测试了钙化合物作为能量储存材料的可能性。
storage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

storage.sentenceEn: Recently, I've been spending a lot more time editing photos, posting online and clearing storage on my phone.
storage.translationZh: 最近，我花了更多时间编辑照片、发布到网上，还要清理手机存储空间。
storage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

storage.sentenceEn: What does Dr. Sadoway think of energy storage ?
storage.translationZh: 萨多韦博士如何看待储能技术？

storage.sentenceEn: They advanced a new model concerning human information storage and retrieval.
storage.translationZh: 他们提出了一个关于人类信息存储与检索的新模型。

stork.sentenceEn: The scientists tracked white storks from different colonies in Europe and Africa.
stork.translationZh: 科学家们追踪了来自欧洲和非洲不同栖息地的白鹳。
stork.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

stork.sentenceEn: Landfill sites on the Iberian peninsula have long attracted local white storks , but all of the Spanish birds tagged in the study flew across the Sahara desert to the western Sahel.
stork.translationZh: 伊比利亚半岛上的垃圾填埋场长期以来一直吸引着当地的白鹳，但在这项研究中所有被标记的西班牙白鹳都飞越了撒哈拉沙漠，前往西非的萨赫勒地区。
stork.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

stork.sentenceEn: Writing in the journal, the scientists describe how the storks from Germany were clearly affected by the presence of waste sites, with four out of six birds that survived for at least five months overwintering on rubbish dumps in northern Morocco, instead of migrating to the Sahel.
stork.translationZh: 科学家在期刊中描述，德国鹳明显受到垃圾场存在的影响：在至少存活五个月的六只鹳中，有四只选择在摩洛哥北部的垃圾场过冬，而非迁徙至萨赫勒地区。
stork.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

stork.sentenceEn: Andrea Flack of the Max Planck Institute found that birds following traditional migration routes were more likely to die than German storks that flew only as far as northern Morocco, and spent the winter there on rubbish dumps.
stork.translationZh: 马克斯·普朗克研究所的安德里亚·弗拉克发现，遵循传统迁徙路线的鹳比那些仅飞到摩洛哥北部并在那里的垃圾场过冬的德国鹳更容易死亡。
stork.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

stork.sentenceEn: What is scientists' other concern about white storks feeding on landfills?
stork.translationZh: 科学家们对于白鹳以垃圾填埋场为食还有什么其他担忧？

stork.sentenceEn: They join the storks from Germany on rubbish dumps in Morocco.
stork.translationZh: 它们与来自德国的鹳一起聚集在摩洛哥的垃圾填埋场。

stretch.sentenceEn: Given the opportunity, I will sleep for marathon stretches , and can doze through the most extreme situations.
stretch.translationZh: 只要有机会，我就能睡上很长时间，而且就算在最极端的情况下也能打盹。
stretch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

stretch.sentenceEn: "To exist for very long in a community like that, you have to get over the question of whether you're sufficiently talented or principled and get started worrying about how you can stretch yourself and your peers, how much you can manage to learn with them."
stretch.translationZh: 要在这样的社区中长期生活，你必须不再纠结于自己是否足够有才华或有原则，而是开始思考如何拓展自己和同伴的能力，以及如何与他们共同学习更多知识。

stretch.sentenceEn: For most passersby humming through the Mojave on their way to try their luck in Las Vegas or heading towards the Grand Canyon, it's just a flat stretch of land with some mountains in the distance and more apt to be a setting for a movie that takes place on Mars.
stretch.translationZh: 对于大多数驾车匆匆穿过莫哈韦沙漠的路人——他们要么是去拉斯维加斯碰运气，要么是前往大峡谷——这片沙漠不过是一片平坦的土地，远处有些山脉，更像是火星题材电影的取景地。
stretch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

stretch.sentenceEn: Over the centuries, dozens of majestic Old World sailing ships smashed and sank on this irregular stretch of windy Florida coast.
stretch.translationZh: 几个世纪以来，数十艘宏伟的旧世界帆船在佛罗里达这片风大浪急、地形复杂的海岸线上触礁沉没。

stretch.sentenceEn: The court cases that ensue stretch on for years.
stretch.translationZh: 由此引发的法庭案件会持续数年之久。

stretch.sentenceEn: Stretch out the process in search of the optimal.
stretch.translationZh: 为了寻求最佳选择而延长决策过程

surely.sentenceEn: There are surely endless examples of innovative library services for children, including the Middle Country Public Library's Nature Explorium, which engages children in learning about the natural world.
surely.translationZh: 针对儿童的创新图书馆服务无疑有无数例证，其中包括中郡公共图书馆的“自然探索馆”，该馆让孩子们参与到自然世界的学习中。

surely.sentenceEn: Considering these changes, surely an evolving countryside is inevitable.
surely.translationZh: 考虑到这些变化，乡村的发展演变无疑是不可避免的。
surely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

surely.sentenceEn: I thought that's surely something we should have covered earlier in the section discussing strengths and talents, but no.
surely.translationZh: 我本以为这在之前讨论优势和才能的环节就应该提到了，结果并没有。
surely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

surely.sentenceEn: Surely the purpose of university is to prepare young people to participate fully in civic life, rather than just to find well-paid jobs.
surely.translationZh: 大学的目的当然是培养年轻人充分参与公民生活，而不仅仅是找到高薪工作。
surely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

surely.sentenceEn: The fixation on genes as destiny is surely false too.
surely.translationZh: 将基因视为命运的执念当然也是错误的。
surely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

surely.sentenceEn: If it is, then you can easily send it back to the manufacturer, and they'll send you a brand-new one for free surely .
surely.translationZh: 如果还在保修期内的话，你完全可以把它寄回给厂商，他们肯定会免费给你换一台全新的。
surely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

symbol.sentenceEn: Customers at Sitka, regarded as a pioneer in the country's small farm-to-table dining scene, still seek foreign ingredients as a "status symbol ", she says.
symbol.translationZh: 她说，锡特卡餐厅作为美国小型农场直达餐桌餐饮风潮的先驱，其顾客仍将外国食材视为一种“身份象征”。

symbol.sentenceEn: If you follow all of the guidelines, you need to use a different password for every one of your accounts; use an incomprehensible variety of letters, numbers, and symbols ; sign up for two-step verification; and change every password every time one of them is compromised.
symbol.translationZh: 如果您遵循所有安全准则，就需要为每个账户设置不同的密码；使用由字母、数字和符号组合而成的难以理解的密码；启用两步验证；并且每当某个密码泄露时，都要更改所有密码。
symbol.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

symbol.sentenceEn: We build intricate habitats, devise complex recipes for our food, wear clothes that reflect constant changes in fashion, communicate with elaborate signs, symbols , and sounds, and travel between habitats on wings and wheels of our own design.
symbol.translationZh: 我们建造精巧复杂的居所，设计五花八门的食谱，穿着紧跟时尚潮流变化的服装，通过繁复的手势、符号和声音进行交流，还借助自己设计的翅膀与车轮穿梭于不同的栖息地之间。
symbol.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

symbol.sentenceEn: There is something almost delightful in the detachment from reality of advertisements showing mass-produced cars marketed as symbols of individuality and of freedom when most of their lives will be spent making short journeys on choked roads.
symbol.translationZh: 广告将批量生产的汽车标榜为个性与自由的象征，这种脱离现实的做法近乎可笑——毕竟这些车的大部分时间都将在拥堵的道路上短途跋涉。
symbol.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

symbol.sentenceEn: This is not surprising given Notre Dame Cathedral, meaning "Our Lady", is one of the most recognised symbols of the city of Paris attracting millions of tourists every year.
symbol.translationZh: 鉴于巴黎圣母院——意为“我们的女士”——是巴黎市最广为人知的标志之一，每年吸引数百万游客，这一现象并不令人意外。

symbol.sentenceEn: It has become a typical symbol of German efficiency.
symbol.translationZh: 它已成为德国效率的典型象征。

systematic.sentenceEn: It's best to think of an accent as a distinct, systematic and rule-governed way of speaking.
systematic.translationZh: 最好将口音理解为一种独特的、系统化的、且受规则约束的说话方式。
systematic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

systematic.sentenceEn: "It has to be systematic and explicitly taught."
systematic.translationZh: phonics的教学必须系统化、清晰明确。
systematic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

systematic.sentenceEn: In a study of this sort, a difference of four years is highly significant, and could not be explained by other systematic differences between the two groups.
systematic.translationZh: 在这类研究中，四年的差异具有高度显著性，且无法用两组之间的其他系统性差异来解释。

systematic.sentenceEn: One way we can check our internal biases and inconsistencies is through the social verification of knowledge, in which we test our ideas in a rigorous and systematic way to see if they make sense not just to us, but to other people.
systematic.translationZh: 我们可以通过知识的社会验证来检验自身的偏见和矛盾，即在这一过程中，我们以严谨系统的方式检验自己的观点，看它们不仅对我们自己有意义，对他人是否也同样有意义。
systematic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

systematic.sentenceEn: But the extent to which individuals can do this on their own is a function of how well integrated they are with communities of systematic inquiry in the first place.
systematic.translationZh: 但个人独立进行这种思考的能力高低，首先取决于他们与系统性探究群体的融合程度。
systematic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

systematic.sentenceEn: Changing the current energy system requires the systematic training of professionals and skilled labor.
systematic.translationZh: 改变当前的能源系统需要对专业人员和技术劳动力进行系统性培训。

scratch.sentenceEn: Every year, doctors who have offices near the park treat a number of cases of bear bites and bear scratches .
scratch.translationZh: 每年，在公园附近设有诊所的医生们都会诊治多起熊咬伤和熊抓伤病例。
scratch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

scratch.sentenceEn: Now, a person can be animated from scratch .
scratch.translationZh: 如今，人们可以从零开始制作一个人的数字动画。

scratch.sentenceEn: These can dent and scratch your floor.
scratch.translationZh: 这些都会给地板造成凹痕和刮痕。
scratch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

scratch.sentenceEn: The more dirt you track in, the more it scratches and the more often you'd have to clean.
scratch.translationZh: 你带进屋里的灰尘越多，地板刮痕就越多，你需要清洁的频率也就越高。
scratch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

scratch.sentenceEn: Shoes can also leave marks and scratches on floors, especially high heels or shoes with pointed or hard parts.
scratch.translationZh: 鞋子还会在地板上留下痕迹和刮痕，尤其是高跟鞋或带有尖锐部件或硬质部件的鞋子。
scratch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

scratch.sentenceEn: Shoes can leave scratches on the floor.
scratch.translationZh: 鞋子会在地板上留下划痕。

sequence.sentenceEn: The system defines ultra-processed foods as those made using sequences of processes that extract substances from foods and alter them with chemicals in order to formulate the final product.
sequence.translationZh: 该系统将超加工食品定义为：通过一系列加工过程从食物中提取物质，并使用化学物质对其进行改造以形成最终产品的食品。
sequence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

sequence.sentenceEn: In Britain, organizations including the Natural History Museum, the Royal Botanic Gardens at Kew and the Wellcome Sanger Institute have joined forces to sequence Britain's 66,000 species of animals and plants.
sequence.translationZh: 在英国，包括自然历史博物馆、皇家植物园邱园和韦尔科姆桑格研究所在内的多家机构携手合作，对英国66,000种动植物进行基因组测序。
sequence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sequence.sentenceEn: Scientists say that sequencing every species will revolutionise the understanding of biology and evolution, bolster efforts to conserve as well as protect and restore biodiversity.
sequence.translationZh: 科学家表示，对每个物种进行测序将彻底改变我们对生物学和进化的理解，并加强保护、维护和恢复生物多样性的努力。
sequence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

sequence.sentenceEn: Central to hereditarian science is a tall claim: that identifiable variations in genetic sequences can predict an individual's aptness to learn, reason and solve problems.
sequence.translationZh: 遗传论科学的核心是一个大胆的主张：基因序列中可识别的变异能够预测个体的学习、推理和解决问题的能力。
sequence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

sequence.sentenceEn: Some communities have agreed to share online—geneticists, for example, post DNA sequences at the GenBank repository(库), and astronomers are accustomed to accessing images of galaxies and stars from, say, the Sloan Digital Sky Survey, a telescope that has observed some 500 million objects—but these remain the exception, not the rule.
sequence.translationZh: 一些学术群体已经同意在线共享数据——例如，遗传学家会将DNA序列发布到GenBank数据库，天文学家则习惯于通过诸如斯隆数字巡天望远镜（该望远镜已观测约5亿个天体）获取星系和恒星的图像——但这些仍属例外，而非普遍现象。
sequence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sequence.translationZh: 对其个人基因组进行测序

similarity.sentenceEn: After ties are established, similarity strengthens them.
similarity.translationZh: 一旦建立了联系，相似性会进一步巩固这些关系。
similarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

similarity.sentenceEn: They discover both similarities and differences between themselves and others.
similarity.translationZh: 他们会发现自己与他人之间既存在相似之处，也存在不同之处。
similarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

similarity.sentenceEn: These activities are the fabric of the friendship; it is a "doing" relationship in which similarity in interests is the key bond.
similarity.translationZh: 这些活动构成了友谊的基础；这是一种“行动型”的关系，其中兴趣的相似性是关键纽带。
similarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

similarity.sentenceEn: Men assigned a lower priority to them in favor of similarity in interests, selected by 77% of men, and responsiveness in a crisis, chosen by 61% male respondents.
similarity.translationZh: 相比之下，男性更看重兴趣相似性（77%的男性选择此项）和危机中的响应能力（61%的男性受访者选择此项），而将上述品质排在较低位置。
similarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

similarity.sentenceEn: I specialize in Cultural Psychology, examining similarities and differences between East Asians and North Americans.
similarity.translationZh: 我的专业领域是文化心理学，主要研究东亚人与北美人之间的异同。
similarity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

similarity.sentenceEn: Their similarity is conducive to future collaboration.
similarity.translationZh: 他们的相似性有助于未来的合作。

simultaneously.sentenceEn: They also recommend that people simultaneously endeavor to restrict consumption of sweets, sugar and red meat.
simultaneously.translationZh: 他们还建议人们同时努力限制甜食、糖和红肉的摄入。
simultaneously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

simultaneously.sentenceEn: It is a powerful communication medium that simultaneously provides immediate, frequent, permanent, and wide-reaching information across the globe.
simultaneously.translationZh: 它是一种强大的传播媒介，能够同时在全球范围内提供即时、频繁、持久且广泛传播的信息。
simultaneously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

simultaneously.sentenceEn: Simultaneously , food production has been constrained by a lack of scientific research.
simultaneously.translationZh: 与此同时，粮食生产因缺乏科学研究而受到制约。
simultaneously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

simultaneously.sentenceEn: This is a routine designed to reduce the stress of running simultaneously three different health and biotechnology companies for 18 hours a day.
simultaneously.translationZh: 这套日常安排旨在缓解他每天工作18小时同时经营三家不同健康与生物技术公司所带来的压力。
simultaneously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

simultaneously.sentenceEn: Simultaneously , dramatic drops in communication costs ease long-distance interactions.
simultaneously.translationZh: 与此同时，通讯成本的大幅下降也为远程交流提供了便利。
simultaneously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

skilled.sentenceEn: The restaurant industry is currently suffering a severe shortage of skilled chefs — a deficit of 11,000, according to the skills agency People 1st.
skilled.translationZh: 餐饮业目前正面临着熟练厨师严重短缺的问题——根据技能评估机构 People 1st 的数据，这一缺口已达 1.1 万人。

skilled.sentenceEn: Left-brained people are supposedly logical and excel at language and math while right-brained people are more imaginative, emotionally intelligent and skilled with spatial reasoning.
skilled.translationZh: 据说左脑型的人逻辑性强，擅长语言和数学，而右脑型的人则更富有想象力，情商更高，并且在空间推理方面更有天赋。
skilled.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

skilled.sentenceEn: He was also a skilled and sophisticated organizer, an entrepreneurial innovator, who mastered the use of corporate strategy, media relations, government lobbying, international diplomacy, patents, and prosecution.
skilled.translationZh: 他还是一位技艺高超、精明老练的组织者，一位富有创业精神的创新者，精通企业战略、媒体关系、政府游说、国际外交、专利申请以及专利诉讼。

skilled.sentenceEn: Smart basketball players or skilled musicians need to pay close attention to the demands of high performance, to the challenges to be overcome.
skilled.translationZh: 聪明的篮球运动员或技艺精湛的音乐家需要密切关注高水平表现的要求，关注需要克服的挑战。
skilled.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

skilled.sentenceEn: Changing the current energy system requires the systematic training of professionals and skilled labor.
skilled.translationZh: 改变当前的能源系统需要对专业人员和技术劳动力进行系统性培训。

skilled.sentenceEn: Manufacturers had to employ more highly skilled workers.
skilled.translationZh: 制造商不得不雇佣更多高技能工人。

socialize.sentenceEn: Almost 30% said they socialized with friends, family or neighbors once a week or less.
socialize.translationZh: 近30%的老年人表示，他们每周与朋友、家人或邻居的社交活动只有一次或更少。
socialize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

socialize.sentenceEn: Marketing may help socialize children as consumers, inform them about products, and help them carve out unique identities as they reach adulthood.
socialize.translationZh: 市场营销或许能帮助儿童适应消费者角色，向他们介绍产品信息，并在他们成年过程中帮助他们塑造独特的身份认同。
socialize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

socialize.sentenceEn: Less time chatting and socializing means more time working and churning(产出).
socialize.translationZh: 减少闲聊和社交的时间意味着有更多时间工作和产出。
socialize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

socialize.sentenceEn: Sadly, the data also showed face-to-face socializing and sports activity had declined over the period covered by the survey.
socialize.translationZh: 遗憾的是，数据还显示，在调查所涵盖的时间段内，面对面社交和体育活动的时间有所减少。

socialize.sentenceEn: Locked indoors, unable to get on their bicycles and hang out with their friends, teens have turned to social media and their mobile phones to socialize with their peers.
socialize.translationZh: 由于被限制在室内，无法骑上自行车与朋友们外出闲逛，青少年们转而通过社交媒体和手机与同龄人社交。
socialize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

socialize.sentenceEn: They are born with a stronger ability to socialize .
socialize.translationZh: 她们天生拥有更强的社交能力。

societal.sentenceEn: Professor Oliver claims that individualism is actually bad for society, and only by realising we are part of a bigger entity can we solve pressing environmental and societal problems.
societal.translationZh: 奥利弗教授认为，个人主义实际上对社会有害，只有认识到我们是更大整体的一部分，我们才能解决紧迫的环境和社会问题。
societal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

societal.sentenceEn: Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Facebook championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating.
societal.translationZh: 数字排斥是英国更广泛社会平等的一大威胁，因此当看到脸书等公司将元宇宙标榜为下一个伟大前沿，而与此同时学童们却在为完成家庭作业而苦苦挣扎时，这感觉尤其令人恼火。
societal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

societal.sentenceEn: Songs have long been used as a means of communicating messages and folk stories, covering everything from societal ethics to world history.
societal.translationZh: 长期以来，歌曲一直被用作传递信息和民间故事的手段，内容包罗万象，从社会伦理到世界历史无所不包。
societal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

societal.sentenceEn: Soga suggests the generational loss—condition previously dubbed environmental generational amnesia(遗忘)—could chip away at our societal ability to preserve what we're losing.
societal.translationZh: 曾我正志指出，这种代际传承的失落——此前被称为环境代际遗忘症——可能会削弱我们社会保护正在消失之物的能力。

societal.sentenceEn: How can we solve pressing environmental and societal problems according to Professor Tom Oliver?
societal.translationZh: 根据汤姆·奥利弗教授的观点，我们应如何解决紧迫的环境和社会问题？

societal.sentenceEn: They are conducive to promoting societal equality.
societal.translationZh: 它们有助于促进社会平等。

span.sentenceEn: However, a new evaluation of dozens of studies spanning 30 years found that houseplants in a normal environment have little impact.
span.translationZh: 然而，一项对30年间数十项研究的新评估发现，在正常环境中的室内植物影响甚微。
span.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

span.sentenceEn: Not only have we grown accustomed to getting the information we want instantaneously, our attention spans are much shorter.
span.translationZh: 我们不仅已经习惯了即时获取所需信息，注意力持续时间也变得短多了。
span.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

span.sentenceEn: I came back, burned out, and tired, as though I had lived 10 lifetimes in the short span of 14 months, the 14 months I was in the war.
span.translationZh: 我回来了，心力交瘁，疲惫不堪，仿佛在短短14个月——也就是我参战的14个月里，活了整整十辈子。
span.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

span.sentenceEn: The results add to a growing body of evidence that certain psychological factors may predict a longer life span .
span.translationZh: 这些结果进一步印证了越来越多的证据，表明某些心理因素可能预示着更长的寿命。
span.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

span.sentenceEn: The world's largest existing marine reserve, established last year by the British government in the Indian Ocean, spans 554 000 km² and is a no-take zone throughout.
span.translationZh: 目前全球最大的海洋保护区是由英国政府去年在印度洋建立的，面积达55.4万平方公里，且全境均为禁渔区。
span.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

span.sentenceEn: What is the finding of a new evaluation of dozens of studies spanning 30 years?
span.translationZh: 一项涵盖30年数十项研究的新评估发现了什么？

spark.sentenceEn: It's quite remarkable how different genres of music can spark unique feelings, emotions, and memories.
spark.translationZh: 不同音乐流派能够激发独特的感觉、情绪和记忆，这一点相当令人惊叹。
spark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

spark.sentenceEn: "We hope this work will spark people's curiosity and generate more work on the topic," concludes Raviv.
spark.translationZh: 拉维夫总结道：“我们希望这项工作能激发人们的好奇心，并推动更多关于这一主题的研究。”
spark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

spark.sentenceEn: In 1913, classical music sparked a riot in Paris.
spark.translationZh: 1913年，古典音乐在巴黎引发了一场骚乱。

spark.sentenceEn: EAT-Lancet claimed its intention was to " spark conversations" among all Indian stakeholders.
spark.translationZh: EAT-柳叶刀委员会声称其意图是在印度所有利益相关者中“引发对话”。
spark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

spark.sentenceEn: In a statement on its website, the company says it wants Barbies to look more like real people, and to give "girls everywhere … infinitely more ways to spark their imagination and play out their stories."
spark.translationZh: 该公司在其网站上发表声明称，希望芭比娃娃看起来更像真实的人，并为“世界各地的女孩……提供无限多的方式来激发她们的想象力，演绎她们的故事。”
spark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

spark.sentenceEn: It intends them to spark conversations among all Indian stakeholders.
spark.translationZh: 其意图是在印度所有利益相关者之间引发讨论。

specialize.sentenceEn: M: Is there any medical branch that you would like to specialize in?
specialize.translationZh: 男：你有想专攻的医学分支吗？
specialize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

specialize.sentenceEn: I specialize in Cultural Psychology, examining similarities and differences between East Asians and North Americans.
specialize.translationZh: 我的专业领域是文化心理学，主要研究东亚人与北美人之间的异同。
specialize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

specialize.sentenceEn: W: Well, at the moment, I specialize in quantitative advertising research, which means that I do two types of projects.
specialize.translationZh: 女：目前，我专门从事定量广告研究，这意味着我负责两类项目。
specialize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

specialize.sentenceEn: Online rating platforms— specializing in hotels, restaurants, apartments, and taxis—allow travelers to exchange reviews and experiences for all to see.
specialize.translationZh: 专注于酒店、餐厅、公寓和出租车领域的在线评分平台，让旅行者能够分享评论和体验，供所有人查看。
specialize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

specialize.sentenceEn: What does the woman specialize in at the moment?
specialize.translationZh: 这位女士目前专门从事什么工作？

specialize.sentenceEn: It is a medical branch both of her parents specialize in.
specialize.translationZh: 这是她父母都专门从事的医学分支。

statistical.sentenceEn: According to the FAO's statistical database, total direct greenhouse gas emissions from U.S. livestock have declined by 11.3 percent since 1961, while production of livestock meat has more than doubled.
statistical.translationZh: 根据联合国粮农组织的统计数据库，自1961年以来，美国畜牧业的直接温室气体排放总量下降了11.3%，而畜禽肉类产量却增长了一倍以上。

statistical.sentenceEn: At best there is a weak statistical association and not a causal link between DNA and intelligence.
statistical.translationZh: 充其量而言，DNA与智力之间只存在微弱的统计关联，而非因果关系。
statistical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

statistical.sentenceEn: It's an astonishing but statistical fact.
statistical.translationZh: 这是一个令人惊讶但有统计依据的事实。
statistical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

statistical.sentenceEn: The more inputs and statistical information collected, the better the algorithm will be at predicting a range of outcomes.
statistical.translationZh: 收集的输入数据和统计信息越多，算法预测各类结果的能力就越强。

statistical.sentenceEn: Remote sensors enable algorithms(算法) to interpret a field's environment as statistical data that can be understood and useful to farmers for decision-making.
statistical.translationZh: 远程传感器使算法能够将农田环境解读为统计数据，这些数据可为农民所理解并用于决策。

statistical.sentenceEn: Their graduates lack the rigor required for doing statistical analysis.
statistical.translationZh: 他们的毕业生缺乏进行统计分析所需的严谨性。

surprisingly.sentenceEn: Sarcasm and jazz have something surprisingly in common: You know them when you hear them.
surprisingly.translationZh: 讽刺和爵士乐有着惊人的共同点：一听便知。
surprisingly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

surprisingly.sentenceEn: Not surprisingly , only eight people responded positively to the wedding invitations and money requests.
surprisingly.translationZh: 不出所料，只有八个人对婚礼邀请和费用要求给予了积极回应。
surprisingly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

surprisingly.sentenceEn: Less sport, and fewer meetings with peers correlated with lower wellbeing, as did less time reading print media (newspapers) and, surprisingly , less time doing homework.
surprisingly.translationZh: 运动量减少、与同龄人见面次数减少与幸福感降低相关，阅读纸质媒体（报纸）的时间减少也同样如此，令人惊讶的是，做作业的时间减少亦是如此。

surprisingly.sentenceEn: It may not have been ladylike to depict a giant spider devouring a hummingbird, but when Merian did it at the turn of the 18th century, surprisingly , nobody objected.
surprisingly.translationZh: 描绘一只巨型蜘蛛吞食蜂鸟，这在当时或许并不符合淑女风范，但当梅里安在18世纪之交这样做时，令人惊讶的是，竟无人提出异议。

surprisingly.sentenceEn: Why does the author say sarcasm and jazz have something surprisingly in common?
surprisingly.translationZh: 为什么作者说讽刺和爵士乐有着令人惊讶的共同点？

surprisingly.sentenceEn: They present the states in a surprisingly different order.
surprisingly.translationZh: 两次列出的州名顺序截然不同，令人惊讶。

scan.sentenceEn: Neuroscientists, on the other hand, armed with brain scans and EEGs(脑电图), have not been subject to the same degree of critique.
scan.translationZh: 而另一方面，拥有脑部扫描和脑电图(EEG)等研究手段的神经科学家，则没有受到同等程度的批评。

scan.sentenceEn: The agronomist has just flown over the field with a hybrid unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) that takes off and lands using propellers yet maintains distance and speed for scanning vast hectares of land through the use of its fixed wings.
scan.translationZh: 这位农学家刚刚操控一架混合式无人机（UAV）飞过农田。该无人机使用螺旋桨起降，同时依靠固定翼保持飞行距离和速度，以扫描广袤的土地。

scan.sentenceEn: She's using CT scans to measure muscle size and fat, and comparing seniors on a high-protein diet to those on regular diets.
scan.translationZh: 她正在使用CT扫描测量肌肉大小和脂肪，并比较采用高蛋白饮食的老年人与采用常规饮食的老年人。

scan.sentenceEn: Scientists scanning and mapping the Giza pyramids say they've discovered that the Great Pyramid of Giza is not exactly even.
scan.translationZh: 对吉萨金字塔进行扫描和测绘的科学家们表示，他们发现吉萨大金字塔并非完全对称。
scan.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

scan.sentenceEn: They scanned the brains of 40 teens and adults who were playing a virtual driving game designed to test whether players would brake at a yellow light or speed on through the crossroad.
scan.translationZh: 他们扫描了40名青少年和成年人的大脑，这些人当时正在玩一款虚拟驾驶游戏，该游戏旨在测试玩家遇到黄灯时会选择刹车还是加速冲过十字路口。

scan.sentenceEn: Now a company in Massachusetts says that by using magnetic brain scans they can determine with 97% accuracy whether someone is telling the truth.
scan.translationZh: 现在马萨诸塞州的一家公司声称，通过使用脑部磁扫描，他们能够以97%的准确率判断某人是否在说真话。
scan.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

seabird.sentenceEn: Way up north in the Canadian Arctic, seabirds are picking up dangerous chemicals in the ocean and delivering them to ponds near where the birds live.
seabird.translationZh: 在遥远的加拿大北极地区北部，海鸟正在海洋中摄入危险化学物质，并将其带到它们栖息地附近的池塘。
seabird.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

seabird.sentenceEn: Some 10,000 pairs of the birds, called fulmars, a kind of Arctic seabird , make their nests on Devon Island, north of the Arctic Circle.
seabird.translationZh: 在北极圈以北的德文岛上，大约有10,000对名为管鼻藿的北极海鸟在此筑巢。
seabird.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

seabird.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say about the seabirds called fulmars?
seabird.translationZh: 说话者对于名为管鼻藿的海鸟说了些什么？

shadow.sentenceEn: In 2006 the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) published a study titled "Livestock's Long Shadow ," which received widespread international attention.
shadow.translationZh: 2006年，联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）发布了一项题为《畜牧业的长影》的研究报告，引起了国际社会的广泛关注。

shadow.sentenceEn: When the moon slips through our shadow , we give it a reddish coloring.
shadow.translationZh: 当月亮穿过我们的阴影时，我们给它染上红色。

shadow.sentenceEn: Negative energy can then cast a shadow over your efforts to build a shared understanding.
shadow.translationZh: 负能量会给你建立共识的努力蒙上阴影。
shadow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

shadow.sentenceEn: It's invisible to us during the new moon, because our satellite is parked right between us and the sun; the so-called dark side of the moon is lit up like Las Vegas, but the side we can see is in shadow .
shadow.translationZh: 新月期间我们看不到月亮，因为我们的卫星正好位于地球和太阳之间；所谓的月球暗面被照得如同拉斯维加斯般灯火通明，而我们能看到的一面却处于阴影中。

shadow.sentenceEn: This is simply the shadow side of the miracle of markets, which, for the first time in history, have allowed strangers to look after each other.
shadow.translationZh: 这不过是市场奇迹的阴影面，而市场在历史上首次让陌生人能够相互关照。

shadow.sentenceEn: Leo Tolstoy was even bolder: "The most difficult subjects can be explained to the most slow-witted man if he has not formed any idea of them already; but the simplest thing cannot be made clear to the most intelligent man if he is firmly persuaded that he knows already, without a shadow of a doubt, what is laid before him."
shadow.translationZh: 列夫·托尔斯泰则更为大胆地指出："再艰深的课题，只要听者对此一无所知，即便是最迟钝的人也能理解；然而，最简单的道理，如果面对的是一个坚信自己早已洞悉一切、毫无疑虑的聪明人，也无法让他明白。"

shopper.sentenceEn: The researchers of the team predicted that the next year would see a boom in animal-free shoe collections, since they heard shoppers of all ages say they would buy footwear designated as "vegan", meaning the goods were produced without using any animal or animal part.
shopper.translationZh: 该团队的研究人员预测，明年无动物成分鞋履系列将迎来爆发式增长，因为他们听到各年龄段的消费者都表示会购买标有“纯素”的鞋类产品，即完全不使用任何动物或动物部件生产的商品。
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

shopper.sentenceEn: At a time when young beauty shoppers are often turning to Sephora or Ulta instead of department store beauty counters, Macy's hopes Bluemercury will help strengthen its position in the category.
shopper.translationZh: 如今，年轻的美妆消费者常常转向丝芙兰(Sephora)或ulta美妆店，而非百货公司的美妆柜台。梅西百货希望Bluemercury能帮助其巩固在这一品类的市场地位。
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

shopper.sentenceEn: In an era of instant information, shoppers can use their mobile phones to find deals.
shopper.translationZh: 在即时信息时代，购物者可以使用手机查找优惠。
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

shopper.sentenceEn: It's a chicken-and-egg problem: no one wants to spend the money on upgraded point-of-sale systems that can read the chip cards if shoppers aren't carrying them—yet there's little point in consumers' carrying the fancy plastic if stores aren't equipped to use them.
shopper.translationZh: 这是一个先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题：如果购物者不携带芯片卡，商家就不愿花钱升级能读取芯片卡的销售点系统；然而，如果商店没有配备相应的使用设备，消费者携带这种高端卡也就没有多大意义。

shopper.sentenceEn: Thus, such samples can be biased in favour of commuters, middle-class shoppers , or factory workers, depending on which area the news people select.
shopper.translationZh: 因此，这类样本可能会偏向通勤者、中产阶级购物者或工厂工人，这取决于新闻采访人员选择的区域。
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

shopper.sentenceEn: A survey shows shoppers today are getting more concerned about energy conservation and environmental protection when deciding what to buy.
shopper.translationZh: 一项调查显示，如今的购物者在决定购买什么时，越来越关注节能减排和环境保护。

signify.sentenceEn: Americans' growing aversion to spending time in the kitchen signifies a host of challenges for the grocery industry.
signify.translationZh: 美国人日益厌恶在厨房劳作，这给杂货零售业带来了一系列挑战。
signify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第17句
文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

signify.sentenceEn: Some experts assert that this work signifies a paradigm shift in antibiotic discovery.
signify.translationZh: 一些专家认为，这项研究标志着抗生素发现领域的范式转变。
signify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第16句

signify.sentenceEn: Yet, adversely, those who listened to the critical audio clips were noted as having a higher heart rate and sweat response afterwards, both of which signify feelings of threat and distress.
signify.translationZh: 然而，相反的是，那些听过批评性音频片段的参与者随后被发现心率更高，出汗反应更强烈，这两种反应都表明存在威胁感和痛苦情绪。
signify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

signify.sentenceEn: What does the passage say signifies a host of challenges for America's grocery industry?
signify.translationZh: 文中提到的哪些迹象表明美国食品零售业正面临诸多挑战？

signify.sentenceEn: They signify the popularity of interactive advertising.
signify.translationZh: 它们表明了互动广告的受欢迎程度。

skeptical.sentenceEn: She's scientifically-minded, practical, somewhat cynical, and always skeptical .
skeptical.translationZh: 她具有科学思维，注重实际，略带愤世嫉俗，且总是持怀疑态度。
skeptical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

skeptical.sentenceEn: And the public in general has grown increasingly skeptical of social media companies.
skeptical.translationZh: 而且普通民众对社交媒体公司的怀疑也日益加深。
skeptical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

skeptical.sentenceEn: In the past, people might have been skeptical of a new product claimed to be able to achieve amazing cleaning results, but they now have faith in technology's ability to do what was once thought impossible.
skeptical.translationZh: 过去，人们可能会对声称能实现惊人清洁效果的新产品持怀疑态度，但现在他们相信技术能够做到曾经被认为不可能的事情。
skeptical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

skeptical.sentenceEn: Schellenberg took that news in stride while continuing to cast a skeptical eye on the research in his field.
skeptical.translationZh: 舍伦贝格从容接受了这一结果，同时继续对其所在领域的研究持怀疑态度。

skeptical.sentenceEn: Schellenberg had long been skeptical of the science supporting claims that music education enhances children's abstract reasoning, math, or language skills.
skeptical.translationZh: 舍伦贝格长期以来一直对那些声称音乐教育能提高儿童抽象推理能力、数学能力或语言能力的科学依据持怀疑态度。

skeptical.sentenceEn: I sincerely hope that those who assert that automation will make us more effective and pave the way for new occupations are right, but the reality of automation's detrimental effects on workers makes me skeptical .
skeptical.translationZh: 我真诚地希望那些声称自动化将提高我们的效率并为新职业铺平道路的人是对的，但自动化对工人造成的不利影响的现实让我持怀疑态度。
skeptical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

slight.sentenceEn: Honestly, the difference is not that profound, but if you're in a position to photograph the supermoon next to something that shows the slight increase in scale, it can look pretty cool.
slight.translationZh: 说实话，差异并没有那么显著，但如果你能将超级月亮与某个参照物一起拍摄，以显示其略微增大的尺寸，效果会非常酷炫。

slight.sentenceEn: Instrumental music will have at worst a slight effect.
slight.translationZh: 器乐音乐最坏情况下也只会产生轻微影响。
slight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

slight.sentenceEn: If Paris was cast aside, the tradition of beauty was also to some degree slighted .
slight.translationZh: 如果抛弃了巴黎（的时尚模式），那么对美的传统追求在某种程度上也会受到轻视。
slight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

slight.sentenceEn: Scan the highlights of this year's Consumer Electronics Show (CES), and you may get a slight feeling of having seen them before.
slight.translationZh: 浏览今年消费电子展（CES）的亮点，你可能会略感似曾相识。

slight.sentenceEn: Recent research has shown that even if Americans quit eating meat altogether, the resulting reduction of greenhouse gases in the U.S. would be slight .
slight.translationZh: 近期研究表明，即使美国人完全停止食用肉类，美国温室气体排放的减少幅度也会非常有限。

slight.sentenceEn: Children's academic performance may suffer from even slight inattention.
slight.translationZh: 即使是轻微的注意力不集中也可能影响儿童的学业表现。

smoking.sentenceEn: Tobacco taxes, which generate more than twice as much, have proven instrumental in the decline of smoking , which has saved millions of lives.
smoking.translationZh: 烟草税的收入是酒精税的两倍多，事实证明它对减少吸烟起到了重要作用，挽救了数百万人的生命。
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

smoking.sentenceEn: To reduce or avoid it, researchers have examined the effect of smoking , diet, brain-challenging games, exercise and other strategies.
smoking.translationZh: 为了减缓或避免认知能力下降，研究人员研究了吸烟、饮食、脑力挑战游戏、运动及其他策略的影响。
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

smoking.sentenceEn: The study's authors surveyed 12,395 students and analyzed nine risk behaviors, including excessive alcohol use, illegal drug use, heavy smoking , high media use and truancy(逃学).
smoking.translationZh: 该研究的作者调查了12395名学生，并分析了九种风险行为，包括过量饮酒、使用非法药物、大量吸烟、过度使用媒体和逃学。
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

smoking.sentenceEn: This approach has led over time to a fall in smoking with numbers having roughly halved since the 1970s.
smoking.translationZh: 随着时间的推移，这种做法使得吸烟人数下降，自20世纪70年代以来，吸烟者数量已大致减少了一半。
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

smoking.sentenceEn: The theory is that smoking should be stripped of any appeal to discourage new generations from starting in the first place.
smoking.translationZh: 其理念是消除吸烟具有的任何吸引力，从一开始就阻止新一代开始吸烟。
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

smoking.sentenceEn: Plain packaging discourages non-smokers from taking up smoking .
smoking.translationZh: 标准化包装能阻止非吸烟者开始吸烟。

snail.sentenceEn: These online interactive maps illustrate the formative power of snail mail.
snail.translationZh: 这些在线互动地图展示了传统邮件的形成性力量。
snail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

snail.sentenceEn: Originally from South America, the snails were accidentally introduced into the Ebro Delta by Global Aquatic Technologies, a company that raised the snails for fresh-water aquariums(水族馆), but failed to prevent their escape.
snail.translationZh: 这种蜗牛原产于南美洲，由全球水产技术公司意外引入埃布罗三角洲。该公司养殖蜗牛用于淡水水族馆，但未能阻止它们逃逸。
snail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

snail.sentenceEn: "The project has two sides," says Xavier Serrat, Neurice project manager and researcher at the University of Barcelona, "the short-term fight against the snail —and a mid- to long-term fight against climate change. But the snail has given the project greater urgency."
snail.translationZh: 巴塞罗那大学Neurice项目负责人兼研究员泽维尔·塞拉特表示：“该项目有两个方面——短期对抗蜗牛，中长期应对气候变化。但蜗牛的存在让这个项目变得更为紧迫。”
snail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

snail.sentenceEn: At the same time, this sea-water also kills off the greedy giant apple snail , an introduced pest that feeds on young rice plants.
snail.translationZh: 与此同时，这些海水也会杀死贪婪的福寿螺——一种以水稻幼苗为食的外来害虫。
snail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

snail.sentenceEn: What does Neurice project manager say about the giant apple snail ?
snail.translationZh: Neurice项目经理对巨型苹果螺有何评价？

snail.sentenceEn: It tries to kill the snails with the help of climate change.
snail.translationZh: 它试图借助气候变化来消灭蜗牛。

sociologist.sentenceEn: As a sociologist , I interviewed college students and professional workers to learn what it really meant to pursue their dreams, which I will refer to here as the passion principle.
sociologist.translationZh: 作为一名社会学家，我采访了大学生和职场人士，以了解追求梦想的真正含义——我在此将其称为"激情原则"。
sociologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

sociologist.sentenceEn: It concerns not only us sociologists , but also economists, politicians and business people.
sociologist.translationZh: 这不仅关系到我们社会学家，也关系到经济学家、政治家和商界人士。
sociologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

sociologist.sentenceEn: More than 100 years ago, American sociologist W. E. B. Du Bois was concerned that race was being used as a biological explanation for what he understood to be social and cultural differences between different populations of people.
sociologist.translationZh: 一百多年前，美国社会学家W·E·B·杜波依斯就对将种族用作生物学解释表示担忧，因为在他看来，不同人群之间的差异本质上是社会和文化差异。
sociologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

sociologist.sentenceEn: The process described by Cutting evokes a principle that the sociologist Duncan Watts calls "cumulative advantage": once a thing becomes popular, it will tend to become more popular still.
sociologist.translationZh: 卡廷所描述的这一过程体现了社会学家邓肯·沃茨所说的“累积优势”原则：一旦某事物开始流行，它往往会变得更加流行。

sociologist.sentenceEn: This was made clear by the work of two sociologists , Richard Arum and Josipa Roksa.
sociologist.translationZh: 两位社会学家——理查德·阿鲁姆与约西帕·罗克萨的研究清晰地揭示了这一点。
sociologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

specialty.sentenceEn: But I find it the most intriguing, because it covers so much and ties together so many other specialties .
specialty.translationZh: 但我发现它最有趣，因为它涵盖范围广泛，并且与许多其他专业领域紧密相连。
specialty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

specialty.sentenceEn: W: Well, I sell specialty clothes through a website, mainly for women who have trouble finding suitable clothes in main street shops because of their height or weight.
specialty.translationZh: 女：我通过网站销售特色服装，主要面向那些因身高或体重问题，在普通商店难以找到合适衣服的女性。
specialty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

specialty.sentenceEn: Fact-checking with a scientist who works in the specialty will prevent the unintentional spread of misinformation, and the process of doing so may yield tiny pieces of interesting new information that can be incorporated.
specialty.translationZh: 与该专业领域的科学家进行事实核查，既能防止错误信息的无意传播，这一过程本身也可能会产生一些有趣的新信息碎片，可将其融入传播内容中。
specialty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

specialty.sentenceEn: Our specialty here is Italian wines, and these tend to be fruity with medium acidity.
specialty.translationZh: 我们这里的特色是意大利葡萄酒，这些酒通常果香浓郁，酸度适中。
specialty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

specialty.sentenceEn: Why does the woman say she wants to choose internal medicine as her specialty ?
specialty.translationZh: 这位女士为什么说她想选择内科作为自己的专业？

specialty.sentenceEn: It connects many other specialties with its broad coverage.
specialty.translationZh: 它覆盖面广，连接了许多其他专业领域。

statistics.sentenceEn: But advances in statistics and brain imaging have disproved the whole-language method.
statistics.translationZh: 但统计学和脑成像技术的进步已经证明全语言教学法是错误的。
statistics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

statistics.sentenceEn: Statistics about extinction and the gloom of decline will not in themselves get us out of our often self-created ecological traps: instead, they are more likely to result in paralysis and inaction.
statistics.translationZh: 关于物种灭绝的数据统计和对衰退的悲观情绪本身无法将我们从这些往往是自我造成的生态陷阱中解脱出来：相反，它们更可能导致人们陷入麻痹和不作为的状态。

statistics.sentenceEn: Statistics specialists, when they speak of national averages, often make the same mistake.
statistics.translationZh: 统计专家在谈论全国平均值时，也常常犯同样的错误。
statistics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

statistics.sentenceEn: Therefore, a new discipline blending computer science, programming, statistics and machine learning should be added to the traditional foundational topics of mathematics and physics.
statistics.translationZh: 因此，在数学和物理这些传统基础学科之外，还应当增设一门融合计算机科学、编程、统计学和机器学习的新学科。

statistics.sentenceEn: Andrew Hacker, Queens College political science professor, thinks that advanced algebra and other higher-level math should be cut from curricula in favor of courses with more routine usefulness, like statistics .
statistics.translationZh: 皇后学院政治学教授安德鲁·哈克认为，应从课程中删除高等代数和其他高等数学，转而开设统计学等更具日常实用性的课程。
statistics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

statistics.sentenceEn: What have advances in statistics and brain imaging proved ineffective?
statistics.translationZh: 统计学和脑成像技术的进步证明了什么方法是无效的？

strain.sentenceEn: According to a study published in the journal Cell, the compound successfully removed deadly strains of bacteria in mice which are resistant to all known antibiotics.
strain.translationZh: 根据发表在《细胞》期刊上的一项研究，该化合物成功清除了小鼠体内对所有已知抗生素具有耐药性的致命菌株。
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

strain.sentenceEn: This will put a long-term strain on the ability of developing economies to feed their own people.
strain.translationZh: 这将对发展中经济体养活本国人民的能力造成长期压力。
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

strain.sentenceEn: There is no reason why visitors to the UK, or domestic tourists on holiday in hotspots such as Cornwall, should be exempt from taxation-particularly when vital local services including waste collection, park maintenance and arts and culture spending are under unprecedented strain .
strain.translationZh: 没有理由免除前往英国的游客或在康沃尔等热门景点度假的国内游客的税项——尤其是当垃圾收集、公园维护以及艺术文化支出等重要地方服务正面临前所未有的压力时。
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

strain.sentenceEn: Over the next year and a half investigators will test the various strains of salt-tolerant rice they've bred.
strain.translationZh: 在未来一年半的时间里，研究人员将对他们培育的各种耐盐水稻品种进行测试。
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

strain.sentenceEn: The problem has grown into such epidemic proportions that this severe strain of resistant bacteria is being blamed for nearly 700,000 deaths each year throughout the world, and, unfortunately, health experts worry that the number will rise to 10 million or more on a yearly basis by 2050.
strain.translationZh: 这一问题已发展成流行病规模，这种严重的耐药菌菌株每年在全球造成近70万人死亡。不幸的是，卫生专家担忧，到2050年，这一数字将上升至每年1000万甚至更多。
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

strain.sentenceEn: So that the message is there, turning every single word into the target language would put too much strain on the interpreter and slow down the whole process too much.
strain.translationZh: 为了确保信息完整传达，将每个词都逐字翻译成目标语言会给口译员带来太大压力，也会大大拖慢整个过程。
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第4句

stroke.sentenceEn: In the same way, the idea that the resolution of age-associated disease like heart disease and stroke will inform us about ageing is not based on sound science or logic.
stroke.translationZh: 同理，认为解决心脏病和中风等与年龄相关的疾病就能帮助我们了解衰老过程的观点，是缺乏可靠科学依据和逻辑基础的。
stroke.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

stroke.sentenceEn: They're also consulting with each other electronically—sometimes to make split-second decisions on heart attacks and strokes .
stroke.translationZh: 医生们还通过电子方式相互咨询——有时是为了在心脏病发作和中风时做出瞬间决策。

stroke.sentenceEn: The fact that we now imagine our planet as a whole does not mean that the 'rescue' of our planet will come with one big global stroke of genius and technology.
stroke.translationZh: 如今我们将地球视为一个整体，但这并不意味着拯救地球的方法会是某种全球性的天才创见或技术突破。

stroke.sentenceEn: The condition is most often caused by a stroke or traumatic brain injury.
stroke.translationZh: 这种病症最常见的病因是中风或创伤性脑损伤。
stroke.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

stroke.sentenceEn: It might be wrong to expect that our world would be saved at one stroke with some miraculous technology.
stroke.translationZh: 期望我们的世界能凭借某种神奇技术一蹴而就地得到拯救，这或许是错误的。

stroke.sentenceEn: Prevention of heart disease and stroke will increase life expectancy.
stroke.translationZh: 预防心脏病和中风将会提高预期寿命。

stunning.sentenceEn: The Ambury Hills above the village remain untouched by human development, and the Sonora Valley just below it is equally stunning .
stunning.translationZh: 村庄上方的安伯里山群仍未受到人类开发的影响，而山脚下的索诺拉山谷同样令人惊叹。
stunning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

stunning.sentenceEn: Many of the destinations I visit have stunning scenery.
stunning.translationZh: 我去过的许多地方都有着令人惊叹的风景。
stunning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第18段，第2句

stunning.sentenceEn: The paintings may yield even more stunning surprises as additional sections are put together, like pieces of a puzzle.
stunning.translationZh: 随着更多壁画残片像拼图一样被拼接起来，这些画作可能还会带来更多令人惊叹的发现。
stunning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

stunning.sentenceEn: Climate scientists described the phenomenon as " stunning ."
stunning.translationZh: 气候科学家称这一现象“令人震惊”。
stunning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

stunning.sentenceEn: "It was kind of stunning when she sort of dropped off into oblivion(遗忘)," said Dr. Etheridge.
stunning.translationZh: 埃瑟里奇博士说：“她就这样湮没在历史长河中，真是令人震惊。”

stunning.sentenceEn: What did climate scientists describe as " stunning "?
stunning.translationZh: 气候科学家将什么描述为“惊人”？

scarcity.sentenceEn: When people face scarcity , they give themselves the freedom to use resources in less conventional ways because they have to.
scarcity.translationZh: 当人们面临资源匮乏时，他们不得不给自己以更大的自由度，以非常规方式使用资源。
scarcity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

scarcity.sentenceEn: In a 2015 study which examined how thinking about scarcity or abundance influences how creatively people use their resources, Ravi Mehta at the University of Illinois and Meng Zhu at Johns Hopkins University found that people simply have no incentive to use what's available to them in novel ways.
scarcity.translationZh: 2015年的一项研究探讨了对稀缺或充裕的思考如何影响人们创造性地利用资源的方式。伊利诺伊大学的拉维·梅塔和约翰·霍普金斯大学的朱萌发现，人们根本没有动力以新颖的方式利用可用资源。
scarcity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

scarcity.sentenceEn: Despite the relative scarcity of research behind the subject, Hartman has taught herself many of the same tricks suggested in Mroz's study, and has come a long way since her days of being stuck with unnecessary meetings.
scarcity.translationZh: 尽管该领域的相关研究相对匮乏，哈特曼还是自学了许多与姆罗兹研究中建议的相同技巧，并且从过去被困在不必要会议中的日子里取得了长足进步。

scarcity.sentenceEn: Water scarcity is the curse of some of the poorest regions on Earth, leaving developing countries increasingly unable to feed themselves, and causing hardship for millions of people.
scarcity.translationZh: 水资源短缺是地球上一些最贫困地区的祸根，导致发展中国家越来越难以自给自足，并给数百万人带来苦难。
scarcity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

scarcity.sentenceEn: What is said about water scarcity in some of the poorest regions?
scarcity.translationZh: 关于地球上一些最贫困地区的水资源短缺问题，文章提到了什么？

scarcity.sentenceEn: Scarcity or abundance of resources has little impact on people's creativity.
scarcity.translationZh: 资源的稀缺或充裕对人们的创造力影响甚微。

shoot.sentenceEn: Fortunately, it's extremely easy to shoot something these days.
shoot.translationZh: 幸运的是，如今拍摄视频变得异常简单。
shoot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

shoot.sentenceEn: The last passenger pigeons killed in the wild were shot in 1899.
shoot.translationZh: 最后几只野生旅鸽于1899年被捕杀。
shoot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

shoot.sentenceEn: A shockwave shoots through your whole system.
shoot.translationZh: 一股冲击波会席卷你的全身系统。
shoot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

shoot.sentenceEn: For years, nutritionists have recommended that pasta be kept to a minimum, to cut calories, prevent fat build-up and stop blood sugar shooting up.
shoot.translationZh: 多年来，营养学家一直建议将意大利面的摄入量控制在最低水平，以减少热量摄入、防止脂肪堆积并避免血糖飙升。
shoot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

shoot.sentenceEn: The experiment is based upon the idea that farmers who're protecting their herd from lions would shoot and kill lions in an effort to protect their livestock.
shoot.translationZh: 这项实验基于这样一种想法：为保护牛群免受狮子袭击，农民们会开枪射杀狮子以保护他们的牲畜。
shoot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

shoot.sentenceEn: Through satellite tracking of both the herd and the lions in the area, they will be able to determine if their psychological trickery will work to help keep farmers from shooting lions.
shoot.translationZh: 通过对牛群和该地区狮子的卫星追踪，他们将能够确定这种心理诡计是否能有效防止农民射杀狮子。
shoot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

shore.sentenceEn: Nearly 64 kilometers of undeveloped beach and 648 square kilometers of protected refuge fan out from the cape's sandy shores .
shore.translationZh: 从卡纳维拉尔角的沙滩延伸出去的，是近64公里长的原始海滩和648平方公里的受保护保护区。

shore.sentenceEn: Early travelers on the Missouri river reported that shores and bars were often lined with the decaying bodies of buffalo that had died during spring floods.
shore.translationZh: 早期密苏里河上的旅行者报告说，河岸和沙洲上常常布满了在春季洪水中丧生的水牛腐烂尸体。
shore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

shore.sentenceEn: Their dead bodies float downstream until the flood recedes and leaves them stranded on a bar or shore where they lie, half buried in the sand, until they decay.
shore.translationZh: 它们的尸体顺流而下，直到洪水退去，搁浅在沙洲或岸边，半埋在沙土中，直至腐烂。
shore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

shore.sentenceEn: Thus, our picture of Venus at around the time life was getting started on Earth is one of warm oceans, probably rich with organic molecules, splashing around rocky shores and volcanic vents.
shore.translationZh: 因此，在地球上生命开始形成的那个时期前后，我们所构想的金星是这样一幅景象：温暖的海洋中可能富含有机分子，在岩石海岸和火山喷口周围翻腾。
shore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

shore.sentenceEn: When it was built, its terminal was a dock on the shore of Lake Moeris, which had an elevation of about 66 feet above sea level, the same as the dock.
shore.translationZh: 在修建时，这条路的终点是莫伊利斯湖岸边的一个码头，该湖海拔约66英尺，与码头高度相同。
shore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

shore.sentenceEn: The Nile, which begins in central Africa and flows over 4,100 miles north into the Mediterranean, hosted one of the world's great ancient civilizations along its shores .
shore.translationZh: 尼罗河发源于非洲中部，向北流淌4100多英里后注入地中海，其沿岸孕育了世界上最伟大的古代文明之一。
shore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

significance.sentenceEn: M: Generally, young people believe their productivity should not be measured by the number of hours they work, since someone can work for eight hours and accomplish next to nothing of significance for the company.
significance.translationZh: 男：通常，年轻人认为不应以工作时长来衡量生产力。因为一个人即便工作八小时，也可能对公司没有做出任何实质性的贡献。
significance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

significance.sentenceEn: "Experience can rarely, unless guided by a theoretical concept, arrive at results of any great significance …on the other hand, an excessive trust in theoretical conviction would have prevented Marconi from persisting in experiments which were destined to bring about a revolution in the technique of radio-communications."
significance.translationZh: 经验若无理论概念的指导，鲜能取得任何重大成果……另一方面，若过分迷信理论信念，马可尼就不会坚持那些注定要引发无线电通信技术革命的实验了。

significance.sentenceEn: In his book, Stick Figures: Drawing as a Human Practice, Professor D. B. Dowd argues that we have misfiled the significance of drawing because we see it as a professional skill instead of a personal capacity.
significance.translationZh: D.B.多德教授在其著作《简笔画：作为人类实践的绘画》中指出，我们对绘画意义的定位存在偏差，因为我们将其视为一种专业技能而非个人能力。
significance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

significance.sentenceEn: Short segments of the road had been observed by earlier explorers, Bown said, but they failed to realize its significance or follow up on their observations.
significance.translationZh: 鲍恩表示，早期探险家曾观察到这条道路的短段，但他们未能认识到其重要性，也没有对自己的发现进行跟进研究。
significance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

significance.sentenceEn: What is the significance of Vladimir Carli's study?
significance.translationZh: 弗拉基米尔·卡利的研究有何意义？

significance.sentenceEn: It was of great significance to rocket science.
significance.translationZh: 尽管如此，这仍是火箭科学史上的一个里程碑。

sink.sentenceEn: The old military saying "You never rise to the occasion, you only sink to the level of training" also applies to behavior change.
sink.translationZh: 古老的军事谚语"你永远无法超越平时的训练水平，只能发挥训练时的水准"同样适用于行为改变。

sink.sentenceEn: Over the centuries, dozens of majestic Old World sailing ships smashed and sank on this irregular stretch of windy Florida coast.
sink.translationZh: 几个世纪以来，数十艘宏伟的旧世界帆船在佛罗里达这片风大浪急、地形复杂的海岸线上触礁沉没。

sink.sentenceEn: Stock prices rose or sank according to his pronouncements.
sink.translationZh: 股价会因他的言论而涨跌。

sink.sentenceEn: But the steel shells of hundreds of the ships cracked in the icy North Atlantic, and 12 broke in half and sank .
sink.translationZh: 但在冰冷的北大西洋中，数百艘该类船只的钢制船体出现了裂缝，其中12艘甚至断成两截沉没了。
sink.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

sink.sentenceEn: Researchers also point to the time sink that is involved in preparing data for others to view.
sink.translationZh: 研究人员还指出，为他人查看数据所做的准备工作十分耗时。

sink.sentenceEn: Frederick's central idea, that "stove, sink and kitchen table must be placed in such a relation that useless steps are avoided entirely", inspired the first fully fitted kitchen, designed in the 1920s by Margarete Schütte-Lihotsky.
sink.translationZh: 弗雷德里克的核心理念是“炉灶、水槽和餐桌的摆放必须避免一切不必要的走动”，这一理念启发了玛格丽特·许特-利霍茨基于20世纪20年代设计出首个整体厨房。
sink.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

sleeper.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, it has come to my attention that I am not an elite sleeper after all.
sleeper.translationZh: 遗憾的是，我现在意识到自己终究不是那种睡眠质量超群的人。
sleeper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sleeper.sentenceEn: I don't want to boast or anything, but I have always considered myself something of an elite sleeper .
sleeper.translationZh: 我不是想吹嘘什么，但我一直认为自己算得上是个睡眠高手。
sleeper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

sleeper.sentenceEn: Is there a non-biological way to reach elite sleeper status?
sleeper.translationZh: 有没有非生物学的方法达到精英睡眠者状态？
sleeper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

sleeper.sentenceEn: According to a study that came out in March, elite sleepers have rare genetic changes, which means they can sleep fewer hours than mere mortals, without any risk of cognitive decline.
sleeper.translationZh: 根据3月份发表的一项研究，精英睡眠者拥有罕见的基因变异，这意味着他们可以比普通人睡眠时间更少，且不会有认知能力下降的风险。
sleeper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

sleeper.sentenceEn: It seems I am just lazy, because elite sleepers are defined as the approximately 3 percent of the population who are biologically programmed to need less sleep than the rest of us.
sleeper.translationZh: 看来我只是懒而已，因为精英睡眠者被定义为大约3%的人群，他们的生理结构决定了他们比我们其他人需要更少的睡眠。
sleeper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

sleeper.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the passage about elite sleepers ?
sleeper.translationZh: 从文章中我们能了解到关于精英睡眠者的哪些信息？

snob.sentenceEn: Nowadays, the snob cares about one thing only: what you do for a living.
snob.translationZh: 如今，势利小人只关心一件事：你靠什么谋生。
snob.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

snob.sentenceEn: This explains why the first question we will be asked in any new social context is 'What do you do?' and according to how we answer, snobs will either welcome us with broad smiles, or leave us in the cold.
snob.translationZh: 这就解释了为什么在任何新的社交场合，我们被问到的第一个问题总是'你是做什么的？'，而根据我们的回答，势利之人要么会笑脸相迎，要么就会对我们冷眼相待。
snob.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

snob.sentenceEn: The snobs are brutally misguided and slavish in their beliefs about how the superior individuals can be identified.
snob.translationZh: 这些势利小人在如何识别优秀人才的问题上，有着极其错误且盲从的信念。
snob.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

snob.sentenceEn: We worry because we suspect—not wrongly—that the world is full of a frightening sort of person ready to judge us ruthlessly and swiftly: a person we can call a snob .
snob.translationZh: 我们感到忧虑，因为我们不无道理地怀疑：世界上充斥着一种可怕的人，他们随时准备对我们进行无情而迅速的评判——我们可以称这种人为势利小人。
snob.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

snob.sentenceEn: For snobs , it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect.
snob.translationZh: 对于势利小人而言，只有那些已经获得赞誉和成功的人才值得尊重。
snob.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

snob.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the passage about today's snobs ?
snob.translationZh: 从这段文字中，我们对当今的势利小人有何了解？

spacecraft.sentenceEn: Food crops could be engineered to produce tardigrade proteins, allowing these organisms to grow more efficiently on spacecraft where levels of radiation are elevated compared with on Earth.
spacecraft.translationZh: 粮食作物可以通过基因工程改造来产生水熊虫蛋白质，使这些生物体能够在辐射水平高于地球的航天器上更高效地生长。
spacecraft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

spacecraft.sentenceEn: Nearly 1.5 million visitors flock here every year to watch rockets, spacecraft , and satellites blast off into the solar system from Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex.
spacecraft.translationZh: 每年有近150万游客涌向这里，在肯尼迪航天中心游客综合区观看火箭、航天器和卫星发射升空，飞向太阳系。

spacecraft.sentenceEn: Russian and American spacecraft also found hints that its ancient climate might have been wetter, cooler, and possibly even friendly to life.
spacecraft.translationZh: 俄罗斯和美国的航天器也发现了一些线索，表明金星古代的气候可能更为湿润、凉爽，甚至可能适宜生命存在。
spacecraft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

spacecraft.sentenceEn: That's why this new policy also includes directions to update the current U.S. Government Orbital Debris Mitigation Standard Practices, which already require any entity that launches a satellite or spacecraft to vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris.
spacecraft.translationZh: 这就是为什么这项新政策还包括更新现行《美国政府轨道碎片减缓标准规范》的指示，该规范已要求任何发射卫星或航天器的实体必须认真分析其行为（无论是意外故障还是正常运行）产生更多太空碎片的可能性。
spacecraft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

spacecraft.sentenceEn: The first CubeSat was created in the early 2000s, as a way of enabling Stanford graduate students to design, build, test and operate a spacecraft with similar capabilities to the USSR's Sputnik(前苏联的人造卫星).
spacecraft.translationZh: 首个立方体卫星诞生于21世纪初，旨在让斯坦福大学的研究生能够设计、建造、测试并操作一艘与苏联人造卫星“斯普特尼克”功能相似的航天器。

spacecraft.sentenceEn: It could also insist on checking private manned spacecraft as thoroughly as it does commercial aircraft.
spacecraft.translationZh: 它还可能坚持像检查商用飞机那样对私人载人航天器进行彻底检查。
spacecraft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

specialized.sentenceEn: In short, the Bay Area has become a global magnet for those with specialized skills, which has in turn helped fuel economic enthusiasm, and this economic growth has reduced unemployment to 3.4%, an admirable feat.
specialized.translationZh: 简言之，旧金山湾区已成为吸引全球专业人才的磁石，这反过来又助推了经济热情，而经济增长将失业率降至3.4%，成就令人称道。

specialized.sentenceEn: Scientists often use specialized jargon terms while communicating with laymen.
specialized.translationZh: 科学家在与非专业人士交流时，常常使用专业术语。
specialized.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

specialized.sentenceEn: In a new study, people exposed to jargon when reading about subjects like autonomous vehicles and surgical robots later said they were less interested in science than others who read about the same topics, but without the use of specialized terms.
specialized.translationZh: 在一项新研究中，当阅读有关自动驾驶汽车和手术机器人等主题的文章时接触到专业术语的人，随后表示他们对科学的兴趣低于阅读相同主题但未使用专业术语的人。
specialized.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

specialized.sentenceEn: Hillary Schulman, the author of the study, asserts that specialized words are a signal.
specialized.translationZh: 该研究的作者希拉里·舒尔曼（Hillary Schulman）断言，专业词汇是一种信号。
specialized.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

specialized.sentenceEn: The project, in collaboration with a number of specialized IT and agricultural partners, had one goal in mind—to take a variety of academic and physical data sources from an agricultural environment and turn these into automatic predictive solutions for farmers that would assist them in making real-time decisions in the field.
specialized.translationZh: 该项目与多家专业IT及农业合作伙伴携手，旨在整合农业环境中的各类学术与实际数据资源，为农民打造自动化预测解决方案，助力他们在田间做出实时决策。

specialized.sentenceEn: In this instance, the farmers and agronomist are looking to specialized software to give them an accurate plant population count.
specialized.translationZh: 在这个案例中，农民和农学家正依靠专业软件来获取准确的植株数量统计。

speculate.sentenceEn: As to why the author would do this, it's speculated perhaps it was a 19th century version of a click-bait thought exercise on whether it would be legal for someone to deed such a non-conscious living thing to itself or not.
speculate.translationZh: 至于作者为何这样做，有人推测这或许是19世纪版的"标题党"思维实验，探讨将这样一个无意识的生命体转让给其自身是否合法。

speculate.sentenceEn: It is speculated to have been invented by the imagination of the said anonymous author at the Athens Weekly Banner in the aforementioned 1890 front page article titled "Deeded to Itself", which by the way contained several elements that are much more easily proved to be false.
speculate.translationZh: 据推测，这是那位匿名作者在《雅典每周旗帜报》1890年那篇标题为《赠予自身》的头版文章中凭空捏造的，顺便说一句，该文章包含若干内容现已被轻易证实为虚假。

speculate.sentenceEn: Yet while no formal MRS studies are currently underway, one can loosely speculate on the length of an average employee's lag time.
speculate.translationZh: 然而，尽管目前尚无正式的边际替代率研究在进行中，但我们可以大致推测普通员工的延迟时间长度。

speculate.sentenceEn: The research team speculated the two might be linked.
speculate.translationZh: 研究团队推测这两者之间可能存在关联。
speculate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句
